jobs.title: Senior Vice President, POM Product Owner
Technology Product Management Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**
Finance Technology catalyst for technology and process transformation, enabling Finance teams to replace manual, non-compliant workflows with scalable, automated, and simplified systems across the bank.
  
  
Driving Innovation, efficiency and scalability through automation and Integration, these solutions enable Citi to comply with regulatory mandates and empower our businesses to achieve their goals, both current and long-term.
  
  
As part of Finance technology, our products and initiatives adhere to Citi’s strategic architecture principles and support the end-to-end integration of multiple global functions within the bank including Finance, Risk, and Controllers.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities.
  
  
Key responsibility will be defining Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management.
  
  
With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills, tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.
  
  
The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Understand requirements through partnership with business users, cross functional teams, and stakeholders.
* Ownership of the requirement backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.
* Perform analysis and mapping to trace lineage of data and develop conceptual and logical data models.
* Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.
* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Understand and anticipate user needs. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.
* Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information.
* Report control issues with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.
* Develop plans and execute functional strategies, requiring coordination and integration across units.
* Help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results, and assist in identifying and removing product development blockers.
* Coordinate UAT testing with technology and business users.
* Conduct data analysis to document business requirements at the right level.

**Must-have skills:**

* Strong understanding of Finance processes and data flows, record to report, Accounting, reconciliation, regulatory reporting and close process, with ability to interpret financial data. Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their practical applications in business processes across financial services.
* Ability to critically assess where AI adds value vs, where traditional rule-based automaton / process improvements are more effective ensuring pragmatic and cost-efficient solutions.

4.Data analysis, basic, SQL, Python will be added advantage.
  
  

* Process mapping and problem structuring, breaking down complex workflows into components.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured AI opportunities, including defining problem statements, required data inputs and expected outcomes.
* Stakeholder and consulting skills to engage with senior Finance stakeholders , ask right questions and challenge current ways of working to identify root-cause of problems.
* Experience with Automation and AI-led transformation projects.

**Qualifications:**

* Techno-functional profile with hands-on experience building tech products that solve real and pressing problems in highly complex and regulated environments.
* Strong background in financial domain and data modelling, accounting, ledger, asset classes etc. 7+ years of experience as a business analyst in financial services, driving BPM, digitization and Transformation initiatives in a global set up preferred.
* Strong background in Data Management, Data Governance, Transformation initiatives in a global set up preferred.
* Experience in logical data modeling, data warehouse and data fabric implementation.
* Data Oriented, strong analytical/problem-solving skills, related to working with datasets, with an excellent attention to detail.
* A deeply analytical and experimental mindset. Proven ability to use data to inform and validate decision.
* MS Excel, SQL knowledge required, able to query data and analyze.
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Proven interpersonal skills with ability to partner and influence across organizational lines
* undefined

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree in finance or statistics.
* Master's degree in Finance/ technology is preferred.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum/SAFe (certification preferred)

jobs.title: Fixed Income - Business Analysis/ Product Owner - Vice President
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, high-caliber
**Vice President – Fixed Income Product Owner**
to take end-to-end ownership of the
**Fixed Income (FI) Book of Work**
. In this critical leadership role, you will define and execute the strategic product roadmap across Post-Trade Processing, specifically focusing on
**Fixed Income Settlement, Confirmation, and Regulatory Reporting**
.
  
  
As a VP Product Owner, you will serve as the strategic bridge between Front Office, Market Operations, Market Controller, and Global Technology Delivery teams. You will manage competing priorities, negotiate complex requirements, and interface regularly with senior leadership to ensure timely and high-impact delivery of strategic initiatives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Product Strategy & Book of Work Ownership
* Take full end-to-end accountability for defining, prioritizing, and delivering the Fixed Income Post-Trade Book of Work.
* Formulate a multi-year product roadmap aligned with organizational goals, regulatory imperatives, and operational efficiency targets.
* Translate complex business problems into clear product epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable business outcomes.
* Manage capacity and budget allocations across development pods, optimize resource utilization and release velocity.
* Domain Leadership: Post-Trade Processing & Regulatory Compliance
* Settlements: Drive transformation across global settlement mechanisms (e.g., Euroclear, Clearstream, DTC, Fedwire, local market CSDs), fail management, and cash/securities reconciliation.
* Trade Confirmation & Matching: Lead product enhancements for electronic trade affirmation/confirmation platforms (e.g., Trax, DTCC CTM, SWIFT messaging: MT/MX ISO 20022).
* Regulatory Reporting: Oversee product compliance with international regulatory reporting regimes impacting Fixed Income (e.g., MiFIR/MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, FINRA TRACE, CAT, CSDR).
* Proactively monitor market structure changes, industry mandates, and central clearing counterparty (CCP) rules to ensure product adaptability.
* Senior Stakeholder Management & Negotiation
* Build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders, including Desk Heads, Operations Leadership, Technology Directors, Risk & Control Partners, and Legal/Compliance Officers.
* Navigate competing priorities across multiple business lines through structured trade-off analyses, data-driven insights, and executive negotiation.
* Run steering committees, backlog prioritization sessions, and executive status reviews, clearly communicating product vision, risks, and ROI.
* Agile Delivery & Execution Excellence
* Act as the dedicated Agile Product Owner across cross-functional engineering and QA squads.
* Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and acceptance sign-offs.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to quantify product adoption, operational STP (Straight-Through Processing) rates, and risk mitigation.
* Champion best-in-class product management practices, ensuring adherence to change governance, SDLC frameworks, and audit controls.

**Qualifications & Candidate Profile**
Experience & Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
* Experience: 8+ years of total financial services / fintech experience, with at least 4+ years in a senior Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role.
* Subject Matter Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Fixed Income asset classes (Bonds, Treasuries, Repos, Security Lending and Borrowing instruments) and post-trade lifecycle.
* Core Technical/Operations Acumen:
* Solid grounding in SWIFT messaging standards (ISO 15022 and ISO 20022), FIX protocol, and trade flow architecture.
* Comprehensive understanding of bilateral and central clearing, tri-party repo mechanics, and exception handling workflows.
* Practical experience delivering regulatory reporting solutions for post-trade transaction reporting.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Stakeholder Negotiation: Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders with divergent agendas.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Adept at dissecting complex workflow bottlenecks and formulating scalable, automated solutions.
* Agile Leadership: Strong familiarity with Scrum/Kanban frameworks, JIRA/Confluence, and modern product management tools.

**Communication:**
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills suited for C-suite and executive audiences.

jobs.title: Associate Director / Director, Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly driven Platform Product Owner (PO) to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the foundational platform that powers our cutting-edge payments application.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned techno-functional leader with deep experience in banking technology, strong architecture and solutioning expertise, and a hands-on mindset to bridge business goals with platform capabilities. As the PO for our platform, you will work at the intersection of product, engineering, architecture, and operations to ensure our core platform evolves in line with business needs, modern architecture principles, and enterprise-grade scalability.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Define, own, and manage the product roadmap for the platform in alignment with the strategic direction of our payments application.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, QA, architecture, business, and operations to ensure smooth delivery.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, technical dependencies, and delivery feasibility.
* Act as the voice of the platform, communicating roadmap updates, capability rollouts, and platform benefits to business and technical audiences.
* Monitor and evaluate platform performance and continuously identify opportunities for improvement, modernization, and innovation.
* Ensure that all platform-level work adheres to regulatory, security, and compliance standards in the payments domain.
* Continuously evaluate and optimize infrastructure and design patterns for maximum efficiency, reusability, and future-readiness.
* Define and enforce platform-wide non-functional requirements (NFRs) related to performance, reliability, and security.
* Ensure alignment of platform architecture and operational standards with industry benchmarks and best practices (e.g., latency, throughput, uptime SLAs).

What You Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* 12 to 15 years of experience in Banking IT with a strong focus on platforms, architecture, or product solutioning (payments domain preferred).
* Proven track record in solution architecture and design across banking or financial services domains.
* Experience with platform product ownership or roadmap management is highly desirable.
* Strong functional knowledge of the banking/payments ecosystem, including payment orchestration, settlement, and reconciliation flows.
* Technical proficiency in one or more industry-standard BPM tools, orchestration engines, or workflow platforms.
* Hands-on understanding of integration technologies including APIs (REST, SOAP), middleware, event-driven architecture, and data pipelines.
* Working experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, backlog management, and sprint planning.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills — able to collaborate across technical and business teams.
* High attention to detail with excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Exposure to AI-driven use cases or intelligent automation is an added advantage.

What We Offer
  
  
✔ Competitive compensation
  
  
✔ Health benefits
  
  
✔ Remote/flexible work options
  
  
✔ Professional development support
  
  
📍 Location
  
  
Chennai, Pune
  
  
Equal Opportunity Statement
  
  
At Volante Technologies, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion fuels success. We are committed to creating a performance driven workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and ensure equitable opportunities for growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. Together as ONE TEAM, we celebrate differences and foster collaboration, creativity, and belonging.

jobs.description:
**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.
* Support automation initiatives and projects relating to various sub-operational areas including maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reports using

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior product leader who combines technical product judgment, financial-services knowledge, and commercialization experience to turn existing financial and digital-asset technology capabilities into enterprise products for external customers.

Financial Cloud aims to provide digital-asset and Web3 technology infrastructure to traditional financial institutions and other enterprise customers. Starting with customer needs, you will determine which capabilities, including trading technology, wallets, and custody-related technology, should be productized first. You will establish a focused product proposition, a viable commercial model, and a repeatable delivery approach, progressing from customer validation toward sustainable growth.

**What You Will Own**

* **Target customers and initial use cases.**
  Conduct customer discovery and market validation to identify priority customer segments, critical problems, buying motivations, and decision-makers. Select a focused initial product and use case rather than commercializing every available capability at once.
* **Financial Cloud product strategy.**
  Turn underlying technology into products that customers can evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use over time. Define the product portfolio, module catalog, value proposition, functional boundaries, API contracts, and roadmap.
* **Enterprise productization.**
  Partner with technical teams to define tenant and data isolation, access controls, configuration, auditability, APIs and SDKs, customer-facing management interfaces, monitoring, and operational requirements. Choose appropriate hosted, private, or other deployment models based on validated customer needs.
* **Commercial models.**
  Work with sales, finance, and relevant teams on product packaging, pricing, and billing. Validate willingness to pay, implementation economics, and ongoing service costs. Support presales, pilots, and the definition of product scope and commitments in customer contracts.
* **First-customer adoption.**
  Partner with sales, solution, and delivery teams to move customers through proof of concept, pilot, acceptance, and production use. Define clear success criteria and turn customer learning into product improvements without allowing customization to expand without limits.
* **Repeatable delivery.**
  Establish the boundary between standard products and customization. Improve documentation, onboarding, implementation standards, version compatibility, and lifecycle management to reduce per-customer delivery effort and improve the customer experience.
* **Technology-provider boundaries.**
  Work with legal, compliance, security, and architecture teams to clarify service scope, data and access responsibilities, key-control responsibilities, customer regulatory obligations, and service commitments. Ensure product design and commercial representations remain consistent with approved activities.
* **Team and investment priorities.**
  Build a product team suited to the zero-to-one stage and lead cross-functional execution. Align with the Internal Platform product leader on capability reuse, engineering dependencies, and priorities, avoiding customer-specific duplication of core systems.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Senior enterprise product experience, with end-to-end ownership of product definition, delivery, and commercialization from zero to one. You can explain how you selected customers, established product boundaries, and validated paid demand.
* Experience building platform or technical products such as financial infrastructure, developer platforms, API products, enterprise SaaS, financial cloud, payment infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure.
* A track record commercializing products for external enterprise customers, with an understanding of procurement, security reviews, pilots, contracts, deployment, acceptance, and ongoing service requirements.
* The ability to translate complex technology into customer value and engage deeply with engineering on architecture boundaries, APIs, data isolation, deployment models, and non-functional requirements.
* Strong judgment in pricing, packaging, implementation economics, and standardization, including explicit trade-offs between customer customization and the long-term product roadmap.
* An understanding of regulatory constraints in financial services and digital assets. You can identify matters requiring legal or compliance review and translate confirmed boundaries into product and delivery requirements.
* Cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to make progress with a lean team while the product proposition and market are still being validated.
* Professional working proficiency in English for product discussions with international customers and partners. Mandarin language skill is a big plus.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience turning internal technology capabilities into standardized external products with paying customers.
* Experience serving banks, brokerages, payment institutions, asset managers, or other regulated financial institutions.
* Experience with trading technology, wallets, MPC, custody-related technology, digital-asset infrastructure, or asset tokenization.
* Experience with multi-tenant products, private or hybrid deployments, international delivery, or channel and ecosystem partnerships.
* A track record turning pilots or custom implementations into repeatable products and delivery models, demonstrated through adoption, revenue, or cost improvements.

**Leadership Profile**

You understand technology and actively engage with customers to test demand. You can select the most valuable initial product from a broad set of capabilities, make evidence-based decisions, and decline customization that undermines the product direction. You distinguish validated customer needs from assumptions and explain both clearly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A validated target customer segment, priority use case, and value proposition translate into concrete purchasing or paid-use behavior.
* Initial customers integrate and use

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. **Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.

* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.

**Qualification**

* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.

The role supports effective financial control through the identification, investigation, escalation and resolution of reconciliation exceptions while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Perform daily reconciliations between source applications, sub-ledgers and the General Ledger for assigned contingent and off-balance sheet accounts.

* Review transaction details, accounting entries, interfaces and audit trails to determine root causes of reconciliation breaks.

* Maintain exception trackers and monitor progress until all issues are appropriately resolved and closed.
* Escalate significant, recurring or overdue reconciliation exceptions to management.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation MIS, ageing analysis, trend reporting and management dashboards.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements to controls, data quality and automation.
* Ensure compliance with Bank policies, accounting controls, audit requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in banking operations, Trade Finance, reconciliation, financial control, business analysis or systems/change delivery.
* Hands-on experience in application-to-General Ledger reconciliation, exception investigation and management reporting.
* Working knowledge of contingent and off-balance sheet accounts and Trade Finance products is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with DCR (Data Control Reconciliation) or a similar automated reconciliation platform is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to investigate and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good understanding of General Ledger reconciliation, accounting controls, exception ageing and balance substantiation.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and data reconciliation techniques.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, SQL or similar analytics tools would be advantageous.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities within tight reporting deadlines.

Responsibilities

  

Qualifications

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.
  
  
Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.
  
  
As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.
  
  
Visa is seeking a seasoned Director Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.
  
  
As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer-Centric Product: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Product Vision: Define and execute product strategy, vision statements, and product goals. Lead product design, customer discovery, and the development of new products based on market and customer insights.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Leadership: Set a role model of product management for the rest of product management team. Mentor new product managers, set processes. Take team forward on the set vision. Recruit, grow, and retain high-caliber technical talent.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation. Structure and manage complex projects and processes with multiple stakeholders.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.
* All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 5+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Senior product management experience in deep technical platform with exposure to Data management, ML/AI platform solutions.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated intellectual rigor.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience recruiting, growing, retaining, and leading technical talent.
* Experience collaborating in global, cross-functional teams.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Payments work brilliantly when everything goes right. The real test is what happens when they do not. A payment may be rejected, delayed, returned or held; a customer may send funds to the wrong account; an international payment may need to be traced or recalled; or an operations team may need to investigate an ambiguous payment state across multiple systems and external institutions. Today these journeys can span payment rails, customer and banker channels, payment platforms, operational work queues, case-management tools, risk teams and external financial institutions. We want to fundamentally change that experience.
  
  
Within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew, we are shaping a channel-agnostic Payment Exception and Investigation capability that brings these journeys together. The ambition is one reusable product capability across Australian domestic and international payment exceptions - connecting customers, bankers, operations teams, payment platforms and external institutions while preserving clear system ownership and controls. This is an opportunity to build an enduring payments product, not simply deliver another workflow or operations screen. You will help shape a capability that can progressively move exception handling from manual investigation to intelligent assistance, straight-through processing and, ultimately, proactive exception prevention.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will lead the product vision, strategy and evolution of this capability within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew. You will connect customer insight, operational pain points, payments expertise, enterprise priorities, technology possibilities and risk considerations into a clear product strategy and executable roadmap.
  
  
You will lead across related squads and partner closely with Product Leads, Product Managers, Engineering, Architecture, Payments Operations, Digital Channels, frontline teams, Financial Crime, Risk, Legal and Compliance. You will create alignment around shared outcomes, make evidence-based investment and sequencing trade-offs, and ensure the product is run safely and sustainably.
  
  
The product vision extends beyond a new workbench. It is about creating an intelligent payment exception orchestration capability that can ingest and correlate events from multiple rails and channels, create a consistent case and investigation journey, orchestrate controlled resolution actions, provide transparent status back to customers and colleagues, and use data and intelligence to improve both resolution and prevention.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for payment exceptions and investigations across domestic and international payments.
* Lead cross-squad prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, technology simplification and commercial outcomes.
* Build reusable product capabilities rather than point solutions for individual rails, channels, systems or operational teams.
* Deeply understand how exceptions arise across payment initiation, execution, settlement, investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments and servicing journeys.
* Shape simple experiences for retail and business customers, bankers/frontline colleagues, investigators and payment operations teams, with consistent status and required-action visibility across channels.
* Lead product outcomes for case and investigation management, event intake and correlation, workflow orchestration, operational work management, evidence and audit, communications and controlled resolution actions.
* Identify journeys that can move from manual handling to assisted resolution and straight-through processing, with clear policy, eligibility, approval and control boundaries.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape scalable APIs, event-driven integration, reusable channel experiences and clean ownership boundaries between servicing channels, exception orchestration and payment execution platforms.
* Explore practical applications of AI and agentic workflows for context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation planning, next-best-action, response drafting and cross-case root-cause intelligence.
* Ensure AI-enabled outcomes are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.
* Use customer, operational and product data to identify exception patterns and upstream causes, creating a prevention backlog that reduces avoidable exceptions over time.
* Define and own measurable outcomes including resolution time, STP rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness, colleague adoption and exception reduction.
* Coach and develop Product Leads and Product Managers, building strong product discipline and a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.

**Essential Skills:**

* 14+ years of industry experience
* Bring significant product leadership experience, leading complex products or value streams from strategy through execution and value realisation.
* Have strong payments expertise, including domestic and/or international payments, processing, settlement and servicing.
* Understand payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and correspondent banking.
* Have experience across payment investigations and exceptions, including trace and recall, returns, repairs and failed or mistaken payments.
* Have built or transformed workflow, servicing, case-management or platform products within regulated financial services.
* Can turn fragmented processes and legacy journeys into scalable product capabilities, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
* Have driven automation and straight-through processing across complex operational journeys.
* Bring strong commercial judgement and can make clear investment, prioritisation and scope trade-offs.
* Can influence across Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, embedding controls and operational resilience into product design.
* Are curious about AI and emerging technology, while distinguishing genuine customer and operational value from hype.
* Build high-performing teams and coach and develop product talent.

**Payments, Automation & Emerging Technology**
This is not an AI-first role. It is an opportunity to shape how automation and emerging technology can safely transform a complex, high-volume payments environment.
  
  

* Move journeys from manual handling toward intelligent assistance, bounded automation and straight-through processing.
* Determine where deterministic workflows are best and where AI can improve investigations, context-building and next-best actions.
* Explore agentic and orchestration approaches while retaining appropriate human oversight.
* Establish clear guardrails around approval, explainability, traceability, auditability, privacy and access.
* Use exception and outcome data to move from exception resolution toward exception prevention.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

* Think product, not project: Build enduring capabilities and measure outcomes, not just delivery.

As a pivotal leader in our product organization, you will bridge the gap between enterprise-wide AI strategy and hands-on operational execution. You will design, build, and evolve next-generation, AI-native enterprise applications and multi-agent systems that accelerate AI adoption for SAP and its customers. You will combine strategic technical governance with AI-assisted engineering methods. This will help you deliver intelligent solutions that are secure, scalable, and reliable. These solutions will provide measurable business value.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Strategic & Technical Expertise: A solid background in enterprise architecture and distributed systems. Experience with AI-native application platforms. This includes LLMs, advanced RAG, and multi-agent systems.
* Proven Leadership: Experience in creating and carrying out large-scale engineering and AI transformation strategies. Solid ability to influence executive stakeholders. Can align technology choices with business results.
* Modern Engineering Mindset: You should have solid hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering patterns. You also need experience with automated code generation, context engineering, and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines.
* Governance & Quality Focus: Proven ability to set engineering standards. Can create evaluation frameworks and benchmarking strategies. These frameworks ensure security, compliance, and reliability as we scale.
* People & Culture Leadership: Experience in mentoring senior technical leaders. Proven ability to build robust engineering teams. Skilled at creating a culture of continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities / What You'll Build**

* Product vision and strategy
* Establish clear product boundaries and integration strategy across Joule, Joule Work, Joule Studio and SAP Business AI.

* Drive the evolution from low-code/no-code automation toward AI-native, agentic and pro-code development.

* Define the long-term vision and multi-year product strategy for Agentic Engineering.

* Define capabilities for agent creation, multi-agent orchestration, skills, reusable components, workflows and tools.

* Define experiences for natural-language development, visual composition and pro-code extensibility.

* Build a scalable ecosystem for first-party and third-party agents, skills, tools and extensions.
* Drive collaboration, version control, reusable assets, testing and application lifecycle management.
* Establish a unified developer experience for business users, professional developers, enterprise architects and partners.

**E. Enterprise readiness and governance**

* Define lifecycle management and operational controls for autonomous agents and applications.
* Ensure extensibility without compromising SAP's clean-core principles.
* Establish comprehensive evaluation, quality, reliability and observability capabilities.
* Define agent identity, authorization, access control and policy enforcement.
* Drive enterprise-grade security, trust, compliance and governance.

**F. Business strategy and commercial success**

* Influence SAP's broader Business AI strategy and investment priorities.

* Demonstrate courage in making difficult prioritization decisions and challenging conventional product assumptions.
* Balance long-term platform thinking with short-term execution and measurable outcomes.

* Influence senior executives across product, engineering, architecture and business organizations.
* Establish a culture of ownership, accountability, innovation and customer obsession.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management - Sabre Payments

jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

**Soft Skills & Traits**

To succeed in this role, you will need to:

* Operate with speed, ownership and a builder mindset—constantly challenging the status quo to scale our UPI and, eventually, PA businesses;
* Lead end-to-end program management, ensuring timely delivery, execution excellence and speedy resolution of issues;
* Constantly design, execute and iterate experiments to test new ideas and identify the most effective approaches to drive business growth or cost optimisation;
* Leverage data to identify pockets of inefficiency and opportunity and influence stakeholders and leaders across the organisation;
* Partner with marketing, product, analytics, data science, FRS (Fraud Risk & Strategy), compliance and finance teams to ensure delivery of key business goals;
* Lead, manage and mentor a lean and dynamic team, and foster a culture of collaboration that ensures each team member contributes effectively to Navi's goals;
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders such as NPCI, PSP banks and other partners to ensure Navi UPI’s strategic goals are being met; and
* Collaborate with our FRS), Data and Engineering teams to drive our Trust & Safety (TnS) and reliability agendas.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

jobs.description:
**Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering**
**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid)
  
  
**Line of Business:**
Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?
  
  
At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the
**Head of Product and Engineering**
, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.
  
  
In this dual-hatted role, you will:
  
  
**Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms:**
Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.
  
  
**Serve as the India Site Lead:**
Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
* Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
* Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
* AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
* Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
* Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
* Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
* Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
* Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
* Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
* India Site Leadership
* Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
* Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
* Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

**Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture**
We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:
  
  

* Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
* Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
* Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
* AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
* Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
* Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
* Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
* Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
* Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Why Join Citi?**

* Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
* True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
* Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

**And many more reasons…**

***Ready to shape India’s Premier lending strategy across cards mortgages and loans?***

  

**Why HSBC**

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

  

**The Role**

  

Head of Lending, India IWPB, shapes HSBC’s International Wealth and Premier Banking lending business across credit cards, mortgages and unsecured loans. Based in Mumbai and reporting to the Head of IWPB, India the role sets strategy that meets the borrowing needs of affluent and emerging affluent customers while delivering sustainable growth and attractive risk-adjusted returns. You’ll own commercial and operational performance end-to-end - from product pricing and distribution through servicing and collections. Working closely with business and control functions you’ll strengthen digital journeys and ensure fair customer outcomes within HSBC’s risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Success looks like a well-balanced portfolio with strong customer engagement healthy portfolio quality and clear evidence-based governance and controls.

  

What you'll be doing

  

* Define the India IWPB lending strategy across credit cards mortgages and unsecured loans
* Translate strategy into annual plans budgets and measurable KPIs across growth income profitability engagement and portfolio quality
* Set customer acquisition ambition with targets by product and channel and deliver within agreed risk appetite
* Own the business plan and financial outlook including income costs impairment and returns on capital
* Shape product propositions for Premier and affluent customers ensuring they are differentiated customer-relevant and commercially viable
* Strengthen transparency and simplification across pricing fees terms and conditions and key customer journeys
* Partner with Marketing Distribution and Digital to build go-to-market plans and improve digital and assisted-channel access
* Oversee portfolio quality through monitoring concentrations arrears losses provisioning and recoveries using early-warning indicators
* Embed effective affordability indebtedness and suitability assessment and coordinate early support for customers in financial difficulty
* Govern approvals and material change across policy pricing campaigns credit models outsourcing and operational and technology change
  

**What we're looking for**

  

* Bring senior leadership experience in retail banking consumer finance or wealth-related lending with accountability for a material portfolio in a regulated environment
* Demonstrate delivery of sustainable growth and improved customer outcomes while managing budgets pricing and risk-adjusted returns
* Apply portfolio analytics to evaluate performance identify emerging risks and take timely action
* Partner effectively with Risk Compliance Finance Operations and Technology within a complex regulatory environment
* Influence senior stakeholders across business and control functions and contribute in management and governance forums
* Oversee product and operational performance across the credit lifecycle from acquisition and underwriting through servicing and collections
* Embed regulatory conduct data privacy and resilience requirements into lending operations and decision-making
* Establish clear accountabilities decision rights and development focus across a lending team including succession planning
  

**Building India’s lending portfolio**

  

This role gives you the scope to set direction for HSBC’s IWPB lending business in India and turn strategy into measurable commercial and customer outcomes. You’ll shape propositions and journeys customers rely on for important life decisions while maintaining strong governance and portfolio quality. If you want to own performance end-to-end and partner across functions to improve digital journeys and operational scalability we’d like to hear from you.

**Lead Associate,Institutional Client Strategy & Insights.**
============================================================

Req ID: 128715
