jobs.description:
Designation: Associate

Location: India Karnataka Bangalore,Karnataka

Organization: Digital Platforms

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About Us :-**

*In a short span of 2.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***
  
  
***?Monitor posture with Prisma Cloud, Security Hub and Prowler; fix critical misconfigurations within 72 hours.***
  
***?Review IAM, security groups, network ACLs and firewall rules weekly.***
  
***?Enforce encryption, logging, key rotation, MFA and least privilege.***
  
  
***Identity & Privileged Access***
  
  
***?Integrate IAM with the HR system for joiner-mover-leaver; disable leaver accounts within 24 hours.***
  
***?Run the monthly manager certification of off-role and contractor IDs, and quarterly access reviews.***
  
***?Onboard servers, databases and admin accounts to PAM; deploy LAPS and domain-only login.***
  
  
***ISO 27001, Policies & Audits***

***?Maintain the ISMS document set: policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of Applicability.***
  
***?Draft policy amendments for approval; keep the policy register current.***
  
***?Collect audit evidence for internal, external and ISO audits; track findings to closure.***
  
  
***Data Privacy & Vendor Risk***

***?Maintain the personal-data inventory and DPDP records with legal; implement technical controls (encryption, logging, erasure).***
  
***?Run vendor risk assessments and keep all vendor contracts in the central repository***
  
  
***Cadence, Reporting & Awareness***

***?Run the Friday SPOC and vendor ticket review; issue and close monthly, quarterly and half-yearly checklists.***
  
***?Prepare the monthly KRI pack and feed the central security dashboard (SIEM, VAPT, patching, DPDP, change, PAM).***
  
***?Publish the weekly infosec mailer; run trainings and phishing simulations.***
  
  
***AI Security & Governance***

***?Maintain the AI usage policy and the approved AI tools list —enterprise or ABG central accounts only, and no new AI initiative live without review.***
  
***?Run a security and privacy review for every AI use case: data shared, model and vendor, prompt injection, output handling, access rights.***
  
***?Detect and block unapproved AI tools through Zscaler logs; apply DLP so confidential and personal data stays out of public AI tools.***
  
***?Secure AI integrations against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: least-privilege API keys, guardrails, logging, human approval for high-impact actions.***
  
***?Keep an AI use-case register for audit.***
  
  
***What success looks like in your first 6 months***

***?EDR coverage 98%; leaver accounts disabled within 24 hours, 100% of the time.***
  
***?No Critical vulnerability past its 7-day SLA. ?Critical log sources in SIEM with 180-day retention ( 95%).***
  
***? 95% of privileged accounts in PAM. ?Internal audit for ISO 27001 closed with no major technical findings.***
  
***?All monthly and quarterly checklists closed on time; weekly mailer running every week.***
  
***?AI usage policy published; every AI use case in the register with a completed risk review; no unapproved AI tools in use.***

***A Day In Life of a Security Engineer at Birla Pivot***

***Your day moves fast —from triaging the morning's SIEM and EDR alerts and chasing a Critical finding to closure, to fixing a cloud misconfiguration, reviewing a new AI use case with the product team, and pulling audit evidence together. At Birla Pivot, you operate at the pace of a high-growth business where every control counts.***

**What makes you a great fit?**

?3–5 years in security operations, vulnerability management or cloud security (at least 2 in cloud, AWS preferred).
  
?Hands-on AWS security: IAM, VPC, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or Security Hub, KMS.
  
?Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, WAF and vulnerability scanners (e.g. Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Snyk).
  
?Understanding of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  
?Scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  
?Experience preparing audit evidence, writing policies and running review cadences.
  
?Clear written communication for incident reports and audit responses

**Good to have**

?Certifications: AWS Certified Security –Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
  
?Exposure to PAM (BeyondTrust, Arcon), Zscaler, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps pipelines (SAST, SCA, DAST).
  
?Knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions.
  
?AI security: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, securing LLM APIs and AI agents.

jobs.title: Head of Organic Growth, Kraken Pro
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. But a great product only wins if the right traders find it, trust it, and actually fund an account. Right now, our organic engine isn’t pulling its weight.
  
  
You’re going to fix that.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.
  
  
We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.
  
  

* Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.
* Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.
* Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.
* Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.
* Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.
* Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.
* Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.
* Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.
* Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.
* Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.
* UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.
* High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.
* Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.
* Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.
* Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.
* Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.
* Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*
*We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*
**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.
  
  
We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

**Role Purpose:**

The
**Marketing Campaign Lead**
is responsible for translating du Pay's commercial and product strategies into integrated, measurable customer campaigns that drive activation, engagement, retention and cross-sell. The role owns end-to-end campaign planning and execution across performance, paid and owned media, CRM, affiliates, influencers, SEO, content and offline channels, including agency coordination, marketing-budget allocation and campaign-performance optimisation. Working closely with
**Commercial, Product, Marketing Strategy, Analytics and other internal teams, the role uses customer segmentation, campaign data, experimentation and performance insights to continuously improve conversion from onboarding to active usage, retain customers and increase adoption of multiple du Pay products**

**Onboarding → activation | Retention | Cross-sell**

**Key Accountabilities for the Role**

**Campaign Planning and Go-to-Market Execution**

* Own the end-to-end campaign calendar and launch plans, translating agreed commercial, product and marketing strategies into executable campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, messaging requirements, channel mix, budgets, timelines and success measures.
* Coordinate campaign and launch readiness across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Legal and Compliance.
* Manage multiple product and customer campaigns simultaneously, prioritising activity against agreed commercial objectives.

**Integrated Multi-Channel Campaign Execution**

* Execute acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and cross-sell campaigns across paid and owned digital media, in-app placements, push notifications, email, SMS and landing pages.
* Coordinate ATL and BTL activities, including outdoor, broadcast, retail and field activations, where relevant.
* Manage performance marketing activities across relevant paid digital channels and coordinate affiliate, influencer, SEO and content-led activation.
* Adapt campaigns to relevant customer segments, languages, communication preferences and channels.

**Customer Activation, Retention and Cross-Sell**

* Develop and execute campaigns that improve conversion from customer onboarding to active usage.
* Design engagement and retention campaigns that increase active customer participation and reduce preventable churn.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell campaigns that encourage customers to adopt additional du Pay products and services.
* Use approved customer segments, behavioural data and campaign insights to define audiences, targeting and personalisation.
* Develop lifecycle campaigns that move customers from onboarding through activation, repeat usage, multi-product adoption and retention.

**Campaign Performance, Experimentation and Optimization**

* Define campaign KPIs and measurement requirements prior to launch.
* Track performance across conversion, activation, engagement, retention, cross-sell and relevant commercial measures.
* Apply campaign attribution, funnel analysis and A/B testing to evaluate audience, channel, offer, messaging and creative performance.
* Test campaign variations and optimise live campaigns based on performance data.
* Conduct structured post-campaign reviews and apply learning to future campaigns and launches.
* Share campaign and customer-response insights with Marketing Strategy, Product and Commercial teams to support future proposition and product decisions.

**Marketing Budget and Commercial Performance**

* Manage an annual marketing and campaign budgets in millions, including campaign planning, allocation, forecasting and spend tracking.
* Allocate investment across performance marketing, paid media, affiliates, influencers, content, ATL, BTL and other campaign channels based on agreed commercial priorities.
* Monitor budget utilisation, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment, recommending reallocation of spend based on performance.
* Track campaign results against agreed KPIs, with particular focus on onboarding-to-activation conversion, customer retention and cross-sell.
* Use campaign attribution, funnel analysis and performance data to identify underperforming activity and optimise investment.
* Partner with Commercial, Analytics and Finance on campaign performance reporting, budget governance and commercial outcome.

**Creative, Agency and Content Delivery**

* Lead campaign briefs for external agencies in coordination with du Group Marketing and Communications.
* Translate agreed audience, proposition, positioning and messaging into actionable creative, media and content briefs.
* Review campaign concepts, customer communications and creative executions against campaign objectives and audience requirements.
* Manage agency deliverables, production schedules, campaign assets and deadlines.
* Ensure campaign communications are adapted appropriately for customer segments, languages, communication preferences and channels.

**Governance, Brand and Cross-Functional Delivery**

* Coordinate with du Group Marketing and Communications to ensure campaigns align with brand standards, communication requirements and relevant du channels.
* Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics, Technology and Operations to deliver campaigns against agreed priorities.
* Work with Legal, Compliance and relevant control functions to validate campaign offers, claims, terms, conditions and disclosures before release.
* Maintain campaign governance, approvals and delivery milestones from campaign brief through launch and post-campaign review.

**Must have required Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree (psychology is preferred) or any other business marketing and communication.
* MBA is preferred.

**Must have required Experience**

* Proven experience of at least 5 years in growth marketing, customer segmentation, and retention, preferably in the fintech, e-commerce, or other consumer digital business, or mobile wallet industry.

**Must have Skills**

* A track record of leading multi-channel product launches spanning paid digital, CRM or in-app marketing, and offline activations.
* Strong understanding of acquisition and activation funnels, campaign attribution, and A/B testing.
* Able to manage multiple launches and coordinate effectively across commercial, product, creative, and compliance teams.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and interpretation.
* Excellent understanding of mobile wallet technologies and the fintech landscape.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive results.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools and marketing.

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

jobs.title: Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
ASB is one of New Zealand’s leading banks and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. This role sits within CBA India and is dedicated to ASB — you will build and lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability, working shoulder to shoulder with ASB Technology leaders in NZ. ASB is mid-flight in a generational modernisation of its technology, data and digital estate. The agenda is set and owned by ASB’s leadership in New Zealand; India’s job is to bring the engineering depth that accelerates it. The portfolio spans migrating the core to SAP TRBK and simplifying the legacy HOST estate, modernising cards across issuing and acquiring, the full payments technology agenda, scaling Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime, modernising the data estate onto a cloud data platform, and re-platforming integration.
  
  
Underpinning all of it are CBA Group engineering foundations — cloud-first architecture, Golden Pathways and DevSecOps, automation-first testing, and AI-powered engineering at scale. This is not a support function. It is real engineering accountability, delivered from India.
  
  
You will lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability — engineers, platform and architecture specialists, testing, data and delivery talent — organised into squads that sit inside ASB’s tribes and into chapters that hold the engineering craft. The teams operate as a genuine extension of ASB, not a resource pool: named outcomes, shared tribe governance and cadence, common engineering standards, and direct partnership with ASB tribe leads, product owners, architecture, risk and operations across both geographies.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation, you lead the India engineering capability that delivers across ASB’s modernisation portfolio — SAP TRBK core migration and legacy simplification, Cards Modernisation, the payments technology agenda, and the Pega estate — together with the cloud, integration, data and quality engineering that make them land. You will work in genuine partnership with the ASB New Zealand leaders who own the modernisation agenda, translating their roadmaps into executable engineering plans, mobilising squads inside ASB tribes, setting and holding the engineering bar, and carrying delivery, operational and regulatory risk for what India commits to.
  
  
Success is a world-class engineering capability across these domains — one that measurably accelerates ASB’s modernisation journey, delivers to committed timelines, holds the compliance and regulatory bar without exception, takes risk out of complex migrations, and does it at materially better cost. Alongside the immediate commitments, you will build the longer-term edge: automation-first quality engineering, AI-powered engineering, and the engineering depth that lets ASB retire legacy with confidence.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Build outcome-led engineering squads and chapters integrated with ASB tribes, with clear accountability across software, platform, cloud, data and quality engineering.
* Set and uphold engineering excellence, embedding cloud-first architecture, API-led and event-driven integration, Golden Pathways, DevSecOps, CI/CD automation, security controls and measurable engineering standards.
* Make automation and quality engineering a core strength, establishing reusable test frameworks and large-scale migration testing to reduce manual regression, accelerate delivery and protect customer outcomes.
* Drive major modernisation programmes, including SAP TRBK core migration, legacy HOST transformation, Cards Modernisation and enterprise Pega, while managing complex migration, cutover and cross-platform dependencies.
* Build a resilient, always-on payments capability spanning domestic and cross-border payments, real-time processing, switching, settlement, reconciliation, observability and incident readiness.
* Lead AI-powered engineering adoption, using generative and agentic AI for software development, testing, legacy comprehension, migration, knowledge discovery and operational support, with strong governance, responsible-use guardrails and measurable benefits.
* Own the India engineering operating model, including resilience, security, regulatory readiness, cost, risk, talent and capability building, while creating a high-performance culture and strong partnership across India and New Zealand.

**Essential Skills:**

* 15–18+ years of hands-on technology and engineering experience, built on a genuine engineering foundation rather than a purely programme or delivery-management career path. You should still be credible in an architecture or design review, able to read a solution design critically, and able to challenge an engineering or vendor decision on its technical merits.
* Deep, demonstrable delivery experience in at least one of: SAP core banking modernisation (TRBK or equivalent), Cards Modernisation, Payments, or enterprise Pega — evidenced by systems you have taken to production, not programmes you have governed. Credible working knowledge across at least two of these domains is required: depth in one is the gate, breadth is what makes this role work.
* Automation-first quality engineering: Proven experience building automated testing at scale across major migrations, including reusable frameworks, integration, performance, resilience and production validation, replacing manual regression with pipeline-driven automation.
* Core banking & legacy modernisation: Deep experience modernising complex banking platforms, including SAP HANA/core banking, large-scale data migration, reconciliation, dual-run, cutover, legacy decommissioning and AI-enabled legacy code discovery.
* Cards, payments & Pega expertise: Strong engineering depth across cards issuing/acquiring, payment rails and switching, settlement and reconciliation, alongside enterprise Pega platforms, workflow, decisioning and platform governance.
* Modern architecture & platform engineering: Strong command of cloud-native, domain-driven and event-driven architectures, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and scalable platform engineering.
* DevSecOps, reliability & security: Advanced CI/CD, Golden Pathways, automated security controls, observability, SLOs, resilience, disaster recovery, threat modelling, vulnerability management and audit-ready technology controls.
* AI-powered engineering: Hands-on experience embedding agentic and generative AI across coding, code review, testing, legacy comprehension, migration and operations, with measurable outcomes, robust evaluation and responsible AI guardrails.
* Engineering leadership & capability building: Proven leadership of engineering leaders and multidisciplinary teams across squads, tribes and partners, with experience building senior engineering capability, insourcing critical skills and developing succession.

**About the Role:**

As an Associate - Legal, you will support the legal and compliance function of the organization by

assisting in contract management, legal documentation, compliance monitoring, and day-to-day legal

operations. The role requires a detail-oriented and proactive individual who can work closely with

cross-functional teams to ensure smooth legal processes and minimize business risks.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

* Addresses a current bandwidth and experience gap: the function head is presently pulled into nearly every matter, including routine and operational issues, leaving limited capacity for proactive, higher-value work.
* Creates a genuine delegation layer, so routine and operational legal/compliance matters can be owned end-to-end at this level — freeing the Function Head to focus on strategic priorities and matters requiring deeper attention.
* Supports the Company's expansion into Dubai, Philippines, Singapore and the US (alongside India), where legal and compliance support already spans almost every function — agreement drafting/vetting/negotiation, routine operational and HR matters, legal cases and responses, corporate secretarial and statutory compliance, and regulatory certifications, licences and registrations.

* Maintain strong working knowledge of FEMA, ODI, FDI regulations and other corporate laws.

* Draft and vet legal documents and agreements, including documentation for bank borrowings.
* Engage external counsel for legal opinions as needed, and manage that relationship end to end.
* Own the full lifecycle of all agreements – review, negotiation, external review and securing leadership buy-in.
* Provide day-to-day legal and compliance support across functions, including routine operational and HR matters, as new legal and commercial issues surface regularly in a fast-growing startup environment.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI); an additional law degree (LLB) is preferred.
* 8-10 years of post-qualification experience in a combined Company Secretarial and Corporate Legal role, ideally in-house with a corporate.

**Skills & Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to independently run the full Company Secretarial function – Board/Committee governance, statutory filings, and ROC/MCA/RBI liaison – without close supervision.
* Working knowledge of FEMA, the Companies Act, labour and industrial laws, and other applicable corporate statutes.
* Strong legal drafting and vetting skills across contracts, agreements and banking documentation.
* Experience managing litigation, external counsel relationships, and ideally cross-border/international arbitration matters.
* Comfortable working across a multi-jurisdictional structure (India plus international subsidiaries).

ecosystems.

jobs.title: Head of Finance - Tech Solutions
jobs.description:
**IINSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**Role summary**

Lead the evolution and operational excellence of Chalhoub's Finance technology landscape on SAP S/4HANA, acting as a key partner to Finance and Technology leadership. Ensure stability, SLAs, and continuous improvement across the live SAP Finance and Procurement estate, enabling Finance to operate with greater agility, insight, and efficiency across all Middle East locations.

**What you'll be doing**

* Define and drive the Finance technology roadmap on SAP S/4HANA aligned with Finance priorities, enabling AI, intelligent automation, insight, and operational excellence across the finance function.
* Build and maintain a Finance AI and automation roadmap, identify opportunities for embedded SAP AI, AI-assisted reporting, anomaly detection, reconciliation automation, invoice automation, and finance service productivity improvements.
* Own core accounting and close technology (Record-to-Report) across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Advanced Financial Closing, Controlling, and Management Accounting and Profitability Analysis (PAPM), ensuring alignment with financial reporting standards.
* Own group finance and planning technology across Consolidation and Group Finance (Group Consolidation, Group Reporting) and Financial Planning and Analysis (budget planning and forecasting, EPM tools), enabling group-wide management reporting.
* Identify and prioritize high-value AI and intelligent-automation use cases across Finance (close, reconciliation, invoice processing via Open Text VIM, and intercompany reconciliation/ICMR), establishing frameworks for safe, controlled, and compliant AI use and maintaining a forward-looking adoption roadmap.
* Own tax technology across Indirect and Withholding Tax and Digital Tax Compliance (Tax and DRC), ensuring accurate calculations and compliance with regional tax regulations across all Middle East locations.
* Own treasury and bank technology across Cash and Liquidity Management, Banking and Payments, Advanced Payment Management (APM), Bank Account Management, Bank Communication Management, Multi-Bank Connectivity, and Market Rate Management.
* Own technology for Credit, Collections and Dispute Management, Intercompany Processes (Intercompany Transactions and Reconciliation / ICMR), expense management (Concur integration), Vendor Invoice Management (Open Text VIM), Real Estate Leasing (RE-FX), and Project Systems.
* Own procurement and vendor management technology across SAP Ariba (SLP, Guided Buying, Buying, Sourcing, Commerce Automation), Materials Management (non-inventory), Procure-to-Pay, E-Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and supplier data management.
* Run scalable BAU processes across incident, change, enhancement, and user support with tight SLAs and minimal business disruption and lead the Major Incident Management (MIM) on a rotating basis (approximately one week every 8 to 10 weeks).
* Own end-to-end management of Finance technology enhancements in the SAP ecosystem through a structured SAFe Agile delivery model, embedding controlled backlog management, ROI thresholds, and full visibility on change investment decisions.
* Deliver scalable Finance data and BI support model built on a single, authoritative set of finance data, self-service reporting, and standardized, real-time financial reporting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for the Chief Financial Officer and Finance leadership, using automation and embedded AI capabilities within SAP, AI-assisted insights, anomaly detection, and intelligent real-time reporting, to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Ensure rigor in ROI analysis, cost transparency, and financial governance, and ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards (IFRS, SOX, GDPR) with auditability and data traceability across the SAP estate; own portfolio delivery and corporate systems rollout across corporate Finance, as well as owning responsible-AI standards for AI applied to financial data, including accuracy validation and auditability of AI-assisted outputs.
* Build and lead a high-performing Finance technology team, integrating Finance-aligned IT talent under central Technology standards, developing capability across tax tech, automation, and data, and managing Finance and Technology stakeholders (including the Chalhoub Family Office) and external SAP vendors.
* Support Finance and Finance Technology requirements for the Chalhoub Family Office, ensuring appropriate reporting, controls, data access, and governance in line with Group Finance and Technology standards.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* 12+ years of experience across Finance technology, enterprise SAP systems, or Finance systems leadership, including significant experience leading Finance technology teams and services at a Head or senior leadership level.
* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with strong functional understanding across Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A).
* Understanding of AI and machine learning applied to Finance. Embedded/native SAP AI, intelligent automation, RPA, and anomaly detection and how to apply it to real finance processes.
* Working knowledge of responsible-AI and AI-governance practices: reviewing and challenging proposed AI use cases, risk classification, control definition, and sign-off for AI applied to financial data.
* Ability to translate AI and data-governance policy into Finance-specific guidance and controls, and act as an escalation point for responsible AI use across the finance function.
* Broad SAP Finance module knowledge across General Ledger, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Advanced Financial Closing, Group Reporting and Consolidation, PAPM, Cash and Liquidity, Advanced Payment Management, Bank Account and Communication Management, Tax and DRC, RE-FX, Project Systems, Intercompany (ICMR), and Open Text VIM.
* Procurement technology expertise across SAP Ariba (SLP, Guided Buying, Buying, Sourcing, Commerce Automation), Materials Management, Procure-to-Pay, E-Sourcing, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM).
* Proven experience running live SAP Finance operations with tight SLAs and structured incident, change, and enhancement management via SAFe Agile delivery, alongside Finance BI and analytics (single source of truth, se

Job Description | Junior & Senior Graphic Designer

**Company** — JK Events & Advertising  
**Location** — Ahmedabad, on-site

----

We’re hiring **Junior and Senior Graphic Designers** for digital, print, and event branding projects. The level will be decided based on your experience, portfolio, and ability to handle projects independently. **Team leadership is mandatory for the Senior Graphic Designer role.**

**----**

**Key responsibilities**

* Design social media posts, carousels, digital ads, banners, brochures, presentations, and print advertisements.
* Create event branding, signage, POSM, and on-ground activation creatives.
* Adapt approved designs across multiple sizes, layouts, and formats while maintaining brand consistency.

**Junior Graphic Designer**

**Senior Graphic Designer**

* **Be flexible when priorities change.** Reassign work when urgent briefs or last-minute revisions come in, and step in to complete critical deliverables when needed.

----

* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, and Canva.

* Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, and brand guidelines.
* A portfolio showcasing digital and print work. Agency, brand campaign, or event design experience is preferred.
* **For the senior role, prior experience leading a design team is required.**

**To apply, please share your CV and portfolio.**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to work closely with the Managing Director as a finance manager across all Pratibha Group companies, associated entities and investments.

The role will focus on financial and operational performance reviews, management reporting, tracking key decisions and ensuring timely closure of corrective actions. **1. Financial & Business Performance Reviews**

* Collect and consolidate monthly financial and operational MIS from all Group companies.
* Prepare MD review presentations covering actual vs budget, previous month, previous year and forecasts.
* Analyse financial and operational variances, identify root causes and highlight key business risks.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations teams to define corrective actions.
* Maintain an action tracker and ensure timely follow-up and closure of management decisions.
* Prepare monthly performance summaries highlighting key issues, financial impact and decisions required.

* Monitor monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and Working Capital across Group companies.

* Link operational performance indicators with financial results.
* Identify liquidity, profitability and working capital risks and track improvement plans.
* Coordinate financial data reconciliation across Indian and overseas entities.

* Maintain a consolidated statutory and financial compliance calendar.
* Develop and implement SOPs for Finance, Accounts, Treasury, MIS, reconciliations and approvals.
* Monitor internal controls, audit observations and pending compliance matters.
* Coordinate with CFOs, Company Secretaries, auditors, tax teams and legal advisors.
* Ensure proper implementation and periodic review of finance processes and controls.

**4. Automation & AI-Enabled Finance Operations:**

* Drive automation of MIS, reporting, reconciliations and compliance tracking in coordination with IT and ERP teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency and turnaround time.
* Implement automated reminders, digital records and exception dashboards.
* Explore AI-based solutions for financial analysis, reporting and documentation.
* Ensure proper data validation, approval controls and audit trails.

**5. Treasury, Banking & Strategic Finance:**

* Coordinate cash flow forecasting, working capital reviews and borrowing requirements.
* Monitor liquidity, debt servicing, interest costs and funding requirements.
* Prepare financial projections, business plans and investment assessment documents.
* Coordinate lender reporting and financial documentation for strategic initiatives.
* Organise financial records, due diligence documents, disclosures and information memorandums.
* Coordinate with banks, auditors, advisors and other authorised external stakeholders.

* Develop a thorough understanding of Group businesses through regular visits to manufacturing units and other locations.
* Work closely with Finance Heads and functional leaders across Group companies.
* Gradually take ownership of budgeting, internal controls, treasury monitoring and audit coordination.

jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.description:
**Date Posted:** 27 November, 2026

**Industry:** IT Services and IT Consulting

**Location:** VAPORVM IT SERVICES DMCC

  

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Department:** Cybersecurity / Information Security

**Position:** Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analyst

**Experience:** 3 + years of experience

**Reporting To:** SOC Manager / Head of Cybersecurity

**Location:** UAE

  

**1. Job Summary**
------------------

The Senior SOC Analyst is responsible for managing and strengthening the organisation’s security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response capabilities. The role involves monitoring enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, endpoints, cloud environments, and applications to identify, analyse, and mitigate cybersecurity threats.

The position requires strong hands-on experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, incident response, and vulnerability management. The successful candidate will also contribute to SOC process improvement, detection engineering, threat hunting, security reporting, and mentoring junior SOC analysts.

The role ensures that security operations are aligned with organisational security policies, industry best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------

  

### **A. SOC Monitoring and Threat Detection**

* Monitor and analyse security events and alerts across enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, applications, and cloud environments.
* Operate and administer SIEM, SOAR, and EDR platforms to ensure effective security monitoring and threat detection.
* Analyse security logs, network traffic, endpoint activities, and authentication events to identify suspicious behaviour and potential security incidents.
* Develop, implement, and continuously optimise SIEM correlation rules, detection use cases, and alerting mechanisms.
* Perform proactive threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and threat intelligence indicators.
* Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous activities, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Improve detection coverage and reduce false-positive alerts through continuous tuning and optimisation.
  

### **B. Security Incident Response and Investigation**

* Lead and coordinate security incident investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
* Investigate malware infections, ransomware, phishing, suspicious network activities, privilege escalation, unauthorised access, and potential data breaches.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and identify the attack vectors, affected systems, and business impact.
* Coordinate incident response with infrastructure, network, application, cloud, and IT teams.
* Conduct digital forensic investigations, preserve security evidence, and maintain incident documentation.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, escalation procedures, and response workflows.
* Ensure timely incident resolution in accordance with defined MTTD and MTTR targets.
  

### **C. SOC Operations and Team Coordination**

* Oversee daily SOC monitoring activities and ensure effective security event management and incident escalation.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and operational support to L1 and L2 SOC analysts.
* Coordinate incident prioritisation, investigation assignments, shift handovers, and escalation processes.
* Monitor SOC operational performance through defined KPIs, SLAs, and management reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve SOC efficiency through automation, orchestration, and process optimisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews of SOC procedures, detection capabilities, and operational effectiveness.
  

### **D. Vulnerability Management and Security Assessment**

* Coordinate vulnerability assessment and remediation activities across servers, endpoints, network devices, and applications.
* Identify, assess, prioritise, and track vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business risk.
* Work with infrastructure and application teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within agreed SLAs.
* Monitor remediation progress and validate closure of identified vulnerabilities.
* Support vulnerability management using tools such as Rapid7 InsightVM and other enterprise vulnerability assessment platforms.
* Identify recurring security weaknesses and recommend preventive security controls.
  

### **E. Threat Intelligence and Proactive Security**

* Monitor emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and threat intelligence feeds.
* Analyse IOCs and correlate threat intelligence with internal security telemetry.
* Map detected threats and attack patterns against MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify potential compromises that may not trigger conventional security alerts.
* Develop and enhance detection use cases based on emerging threat intelligence.
* Prepare threat analysis reports and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
  

### **F. Security Technology and Infrastructure Monitoring**

* Monitor and investigate security events generated by NGFW, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC, email security, endpoint protection, and identity security solutions.
* Analyse network security events involving technologies such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco.
* Monitor identity-related threats, including suspicious logins, compromised accounts, privilege misuse, and unauthorised access.
* Support security monitoring across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams to strengthen security configurations and improve endpoint and network protection.
  

### **G. Compliance, Reporting and Governance**

* Ensure SOC operations comply with organisational security policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support security compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls v8.
* Support UAE NESA/IAS and Saudi NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) requirements, where applicable.
* Maintain SOC operational documentation, incident reports, investigation records, and audit evidence.
* Prepare periodic SOC performance reports, incident trend analysis, vulnerability reports, and management dashboards.
* Participate in internal and external audits and support the closure of identified security findings.
  

**3. Required Technical Skills**
--------------------------------

* **SIEM:** IBM QRadar, LogRhythm, Splunk or equivalent enterprise SIEM platforms.
* **SOAR:** Security automation, orchestration, incident workflows, and response playbooks.
* **EDR/XDR:** Endpoint monitoring, threat investigation, detection, and response.
* **Network Security:** Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, IDS/IPS, VPN and network segmentation.
* **Threat Detection:** MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, IOC analysis, threat hunting, and detection engineering.
* **Incident Response:** Incident triage, malware analysis, forensic investigation, containment, and recovery.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Rapid7 InsightVM, Nessus, Qualys, or equivalent tools.
* **Cloud Security:** Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and hybrid infrastructure monitoring.
* **Identity Security:** Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, SSO, and privileged access monitoring.
* **Security Frameworks:** ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls.
  

**4. Education and Professional Certifications**
------------------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional.
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager.
* CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker.
* CHFI – Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator.
* GIAC GCIH / GCIA / GCFA.
* CompTIA Security+ or equivalent

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
#### **Job Description**

**Location:** Bengaluru, with regular travel to our Raipur head office. **Reports to:** CEO. **Type:** Full-time.

### **About Elxer**

Elxer has connected Chhattisgarh since 2014. We run fibre broadband for homes and businesses, enterprise connectivity (leased lines, managed Wi-Fi and security), a data centre, and Elxer Solar for rooftop solar installations. We build much of our own technology in-house, including our customer app, field and sales app, HR system and a new operations platform, and we use AI across the business. We are now creating a product function, and we are looking for the leader to own it.

### **The role**

You will own what Elxer builds and sells, and why: the software our teams and customers use every day, and the services we add on top of a connection, a rack or a solar installation. You will turn business problems into clear, prioritised products, take them to real users and prove they work with measured results. You will not be judged on documents or features shipped alone.

You will work directly with the CEO. You will partner with the Software team, which owns architecture and delivery, and with Sales, Operations, Network, Support, Marketing, Finance and HR as business owners. An AI product assistant will support analysis, requirements drafting and reporting.

### **Key responsibilities**

**Portfolio and roadmap**

* Own one product portfolio across the new operations platform, the in-house systems that run the business today (customer and field apps, HRMS, billing and ticketing integrations) and our experimental tools.
* Build and run the idea register, scoring and quarterly roadmap. Decide with the CEO what to build, improve, retire or stop.
* Set clear rules for when an experimental tool becomes a supported product or is retired.

**Discovery and requirements**

* Spend regular time with field engineers, NOC, support agents, sales teams and customers to find the problems worth solving.
* Write problem statements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and non-goals that the Software team can estimate and build against.
* Make sure each business owner confirms the need before work starts and accepts the result before it counts as done.

**Commercial products and services**

* Shape the add-on and complementary products for home, enterprise, wholesale and solar customers, such as managed Wi-Fi, managed security, CCTV with cloud storage and solar maintenance.
* For each one, define the offer, SLA, pricing inputs, billing, fulfilment, support model and compliance checks, then hand over a launch-ready package to Sales and Marketing.
* Work with Finance on margin and with legal advisers on licence scope before anything is sold.

**Delivery and quality**

* Track each product slice from idea to production, and raise blockers early.
* Keep product data honest: correct metric definitions, complete records and dashboards management can trust.
* Plan releases with the Software lead, so changes reach users safely and with training.

**Measurement**

* Define and report product measures: active users by function, adoption, idea-to-production lead time, add-on attach rates and ARPU, churn and support tickets per customer.
* Present a monthly product review to the CEO.

**Team**

* Build the product function over time, starting with yourself and the AI assistant, and later product analysts or owners.

**Compliance**

* Make sure products follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, TRAI and DoT licence conditions, CERT-In directions and labour-law requirements where they apply.

### **What success looks like in the first year**

* One product register and roadmap in use across all software and services, reviewed every quarter.
* At least one platform slice used daily by real business users, with acceptance recorded by its business owner.
* Trusted definitions and dashboards for tickets, attendance and leads.
* At least two complementary products launched with measured attach rate and margin.
* A shorter, measured idea-to-production lead time.

### **Must have**

* 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning a roadmap and outcomes for an internal platform, a B2B product or a service business: ISP or telecom, SaaS, logistics, fintech, energy or a similar operations-heavy category.
* Has shipped products used by field or operations teams, not only web or consumer apps.
* Strong in discovery and requirements: can turn a messy workflow into clear acceptance criteria.
* Analytical: comfortable with SQL or BI tools, funnels, unit economics and product metrics.
* Works well with engineers. Understands APIs, data models, mobile apps and release processes well enough to make sound trade-offs.
* Excellent Hindi and English; clear writing.

### **Good to have**

* Experience with broadband or telecom systems: billing, Radius/AAA, ticketing, GIS or network inventory.
* Experience pricing and launching a service product, including SLAs and margins.
* Familiarity with HR, field-workforce or CRM systems.
* Uses AI tools in everyday product work.
* Engineering degree; MBA a plus, not a requirement.

### **What we offer**

* A leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with the mandate to build the product function from scratch.
* Real influence over what a growing regional technology group builds and sells.
* In-house engineering, our own data and AI tools to work with.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

### **How to apply**

Apply on this page, or email your CV and a short note on a product you led, the problem it solved and the measured result, to **hr@elxer.com** with the subject "Head of Product".

jobs.description:
**Head of Engineering, India**  
  
Location: Bangalore, India (on-site or hybrid)  
  
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer  
  
Level: Vice President  
  
Team size: 50–100 engineers  
  
About Machinify  
  
Machinify is a healthcare payment integrity company formed through the 2024–2025 merger of five industry-leading businesses: Apixio Payment Integrity (CPS/ClaimLogiq), Varis, Rawlings Company (Right Payer Solutions), legacy Machinify, and Performant Health. Machinify's customers are health insurance companies and healthcare payers, and its products combine SaaS platforms with professional services to detect and prevent improper healthcare payments. The company is in the midst of consolidating four distinct technology organizations onto a unified platform and operating model.  
  
Role Summary  
  
Machinify is hiring a VP, Head of Engineering to lead the company's India-based engineering organization. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building and scaling a unified engineering team of 50–100 engineers in India, delivering against the global product roadmap, and serving as the senior technical and people leader for the India site. The role reports directly to the CTO and is a key partner in consolidating engineering practices across Machinify's four legacy entities onto a single technology and delivery model.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end delivery for the India engineering organization, partnering with global product, design, and engineering leadership to ship on the committed roadmap.
* Build, scale, and lead a high-performing engineering team in India, including hiring, org design, career development, and performance management.
* Drive the technical and cultural integration of engineering teams and practices inherited from Machinify's legacy entities (Apixio/CPS, Varis, Rawlings, legacy Machinify, Performant) into a single, unified engineering organization.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards for code quality, architecture, testing, and operational excellence appropriate for a healthcare payer-grade SaaS platform.
* Ensure engineering practices meet HIPAA/HITECH requirements and support the company's HITRUST r2 and SOC 2 compliance obligations; work with security and compliance teams on control implementation and audit readiness.
* Partner with the CTO and global engineering leaders on technical architecture decisions, particularly around integrating mixed cloud and on-premise infrastructure across entities.

machinify.com

* Serve as the senior Machinify leader on the ground in India: represent engineering in cross-functional planning, manage stakeholder relationships, and act as an escalation point for the India team.
* Manage engineering budget, vendor relationships, and resourcing for the India site.
* Champion engineering culture, retention, and talent development in a competitive India tech talent market.

Requirements

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ people.
* Proven experience building and scaling engineering teams in India, ideally within a global, multi-site organization.
* Experience operating in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, insurance, or similar) with exposure to compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or equivalent.
* Track record of leading technology integration following M&A, or unifying engineering practices across previously separate teams or codebases.
* Strong technical background across modern SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), and data-intensive systems; able to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.
* Experience managing distributed/cross-time-zone engineering organizations and collaborating with US-based executive leadership.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and people-leadership skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in healthcare payment integrity, claims processing, or health insurance technology.
* Experience with the specific technology stack used by Machinify's platforms (details shared during interview process).

What Machinify Offers

* The opportunity to lead engineering for a fast-growing, market-leading healthcare payment integrity company at a pivotal moment of technical consolidation.
* Direct partnership with the CTO and executive leadership on company-defining technology decisions.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

jobs.title: Customer Data engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.  
  
In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You will do this independently, often as the sole technical person on the call. There is no senior SE in the background. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.  
  
The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.  
  
Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.  
  
**Why this role is worth considering**  
  
A. You move from building pipelines to shaping data strategy  
  
In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.  
  
B. You get global exposure that is hard to find elsewhere  
  
You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.  
  
C. Your technical depth stays central  
  
This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and pipeline reliability gets used every day. The difference is that your technical opinion shapes the customer’s architecture instead of staying inside a Jira ticket.  
  
D. The career path is real  
  
Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.  
  
**What you will do**  
  
Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end to end.  
Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).  
Run live product demos tailored to the customer’s stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.  
Own the technical evaluation from first conversation to closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.  
Build proofs-of-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.  
Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo’s technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non-technical buyers.  
Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.  
Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.  
  
**What we are looking for**  
  
**Must-haves**  
  
2 to 4 years of hands-on experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or data warehouse engineer.  
Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.  
Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).  
Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).  
Exceptional communication and presentation skills. This is non-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo’s technical capability to a global customer base. That means:  
Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience. You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls. You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion. You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation. You have presented or demo’d something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.  
Genuine interest in customer-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.  
  
**Good to have**  
  
Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third-party pipeline and integration tools.  
Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.  
Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions.  
Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or working with international teams across time zones.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through to delivery, coordinating effectively across Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.

* Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building or using dashboards/reporting tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) to drive product and business decisions.
