jobs.title: Founding Product Manager Voice AI - Karta AI
jobs.description:
**Founding Product Manager – Voice AI**

**Department:** Product

**Reports to:** Founders

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bengaluru

**Stage:** Seed

**Role Type:** Founding Team / Individual Contributor

**Scope:** Voice AI, Conversational Intelligence, Product Strategy, Agent Performance, Customer Outcomes

  

**About Karta**

Karta is building the AI operating system for customer-facing teams. We build AI agents that handle complex customer conversations across voice, chat and WhatsApp. Our agents don't just respond to questions—they understand context, reason through workflows and take action across business systems. We're building for high-volume, complex industries like fintech, where conversations require contextual understanding, objection handling, multilingual communication and reliable execution. Our ambition is to make AI conversations indistinguishable from great human interactions—not just in how they sound, but in how intelligently they work. We need a product leader who can turn this ambition into reality.

**Why This Role Exists**

Voice AI is moving beyond speech recognition and text-to-speech. The real challenge is building agents that can listen, understand, respond, interrupt, reason and act in real time. A great voice agent must know when to speak, when to listen, how to handle objections, when to retrieve context and how to recover when a conversation goes wrong. Your job is to own this experience end-to-end. You will work directly with customers, engineers and AI researchers to identify the biggest problems, design solutions and ship improvements that materially change agent performance.
  
You won't just build voice features. You'll build agents that perform better in real conversations.

**What You Own**

**1. Voice Experience**

Build natural, low-latency, human-like voice interactions.

Latency and response-time optimisation

Interruption handling and turn-taking

Natural pauses, speech rhythm and conversational flow

Full-duplex voice experiences

Multilingual conversations across Indian languages

Emotion-aware responses and contextual acknowledgement

**2. Conversational Intelligence**

Make agents better at handling complex conversations.

Intent and context understanding

Objection handling and root-problem identification

Memory across turns and sessions

Contextual personalisation

Conversation recovery when agents misunderstand

Natural transitions between listening, reasoning and responding

The goal is to move beyond agents that sound human to agents that think and respond appropriately in human conversations.

**3. Agent Evaluation & Observability**

Build the system that tells us whether our agents are actually good.

Voice-specific evaluation frameworks

Automated conversation simulations

Golden evaluation datasets

Failure categorisation and root-cause analysis

Real-time monitoring and agent observability

Metrics across latency, resolution, CSAT and conversation quality

You will turn production failures into systematic product improvements.

**4. Product Discovery & Customer Outcomes**

Work with customers and business leaders to understand where voice AI creates measurable value.

Identify high-value use cases

Shadow real customer conversations

Analyse human-agent performance

Translate customer pain into product requirements

Prioritise features based on business impact

Define success metrics and validate outcomes

Start with the problem, not the feature request.

**5. Product Execution**

Own the product lifecycle from idea to production.

Product strategy and roadmap

PRDs and feature specifications

UX and conversational flow design

Engineering and research prioritisation

Release quality and adoption

Feedback loops from customers and production data

You will work closely with engineering, AI/ML and GTM teams to ship quickly without compromising reliability.

**What We're Looking For**

**Voice AI experience:** Hands-on experience with conversational AI, speech systems, voice agents or real-time AI products.

**Technical depth:** Understand ASR, TTS, speech pipelines, latency, LLMs, tool calling and agent architectures.

**Product judgment:** Can distinguish a technically interesting feature from one that materially improves customer outcomes.

**Customer obsession:** Will listen to hundreds of conversations to understand what is actually going wrong.

**Execution intensity:** Can move from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution quickly.

**High agency:** Comfortable operating without a fully defined roadmap, process or team.

**Data-driven:** Comfortable designing evaluations, analysing failures and prioritising based on evidence.

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the title you held previously.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a feature factory PM role.

It is not a role where you simply write PRDs and hand them to engineering.

It is not limited to managing a speech API or improving a voice interface.

You will be expected to understand the technology, listen to actual conversations, investigate failures, make trade-offs and drive solutions into production.

**You own whether the product works—not just whether it ships.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 30 days — Understand**

Understand the voice stack, listen to production calls, identify major failure modes and establish a baseline for quality and latency.

**First 60 days — Improve**

Ship improvements to conversational quality, interruption handling, latency or objection resolution, with measurable results.

**First 90 days — Systematise**

Establish a repeatable evaluation and improvement loop that makes every release more reliable and effective.

**Core Metrics**

End-to-end conversational latency

Interruption and turn-taking quality

Task completion and resolution rates

Conversation quality and objection handling

Agent failure rates and recovery

CSAT and customer business outcomes

**Why Take It**

**Ownership:** Shape the core product experience at an early-stage AI company.

**Technical depth:** Work at the intersection of voice, LLMs, real-time systems and agent intelligence.

**Customer impact:** See your work change how thousands of customer conversations are handled.

**Founder exposure:** Work directly with founders and influence product direction, architecture trade-offs and company strategy.

**Career trajectory:** Build toward Head of Product or Product Leadership as Karta scales.

**The Person We're Really Looking For**

Someone who listens to a voice agent call and doesn't stop at saying:

"The voice sounds robotic."

They ask:

Why did the agent interrupt the customer?

Why did it miss the underlying objection?

Why did it repeat the same question?

Why did it respond without retrieving the right context?

What should the agent have done differently?

How do we measure that improvement and prevent the failure from recurring?

Then they work with engineering and AI researchers to fix it, test it and ship the solution.

**Obsessive. Technical. Customer-first.**

**That's the Founding Product Manager at Karta.**

jobs.title: Director of Product Design (B2C)
jobs.description:
Looking for a **Director of Product Design** to lead the design charter for its B2C business. This is not a role about managing design output. It is about shaping how an entire team thinks, and co-owning product decisions alongside Product and Business leaders.

Insurance in India is a hard design problem. Trust is low, financial literacy varies widely, and the market grew up on agent-led distribution. You will turn those constraints into a clear design vision, from a customer's first encounter with Acko to a multi-year relationship.

What You Will Do

**Vision and strategy**

* Define a well-reasoned design vision for how Acko customers experience insurance across the full lifecycle.
* Build and maintain a strong point of view on the Indian insurance market: trust dynamics, purchase psychology, financial literacy and the legacy of agent-led distribution.
* Turn strategy into a prioritised design agenda the team can execute with clarity.

**Raise the standard of thinking**

* Set the bar for how problems are framed before solutions are proposed, with rigour in hypothesis formation, assumption mapping and contextual research.
* Review design work at a strategic level: are we solving the right problem, for the right user, within the right constraints?
* Build a culture where the first idea is the beginning of the process, not the end.

**Coach and lead**

* Work closely with product designers to sharpen how they think, not to manage what they produce.
* Coach designers on problem framing, questioning briefs and building hypotheses before reaching for solutions.
* Create the conditions for great work: strong briefs, structured critique sessions and a design review culture that asks hard questions.

**Drive business outcomes**

* Own design's contribution to key B2C metrics: conversion, activation, retention and claims satisfaction.
* Partner with Product and Data to build a feedback loop between design decisions and business results.
* Make the case for design investment in the language of business impact.

Who You Are

**You must have:**

* 12+ years in product design, including at least 3 years leading a design *function* (not just a project or a team), and at least 2 years in B2C in a recent role.
* Experience operating and solving for scale in a consumer-facing business. Pure 0-to-1 experience will not be a fit.
* A background in a scaled B2C business, preferably a pure digital product. FinTech, InsurTech and Healthtech are strongly preferred over Mobility or E-commerce.
* Strong first-principles thinking: you start from the user, the market context and the constraints to form a hypothesis, not from a competitor audit.
* Deep consumer psychology and creative problem-solving, with real curiosity about how people relate to complex, low-familiarity products (trust gaps, financial literacy, decision-making).
* The ability to form a clear, defensible strategic point of view and persuade product, business and leadership stakeholders.
* A track record of leading design through how you shape your team's thinking (coaching through problem framing and questions), not through personal output. Strong ICs with demonstrated leadership are also considered.
* Ownership of design's contribution to business outcomes (conversion, activation, retention, claims or equivalent), and experience making the case for design in business terms.
* A current title such as Director of Design or Head of Design, or you are a founder with a strong design background.
* A strong portfolio showing original thinking and a distinctive point of view, not just polished execution. Talks, writing or case studies are a plus.

Pay: ₹5,100,000.00 - ₹8,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently hold a title such as Director of Design, Head of Design, VP Design, or are you a founder with a strong design background?
* How many years have you led a design function (owning the design charter, hiring, team direction and standards), not just a project or a single team?
* Have you worked in a B2C / consumer-facing product for at least 2 years in a recent role?
* How many total years of product design experience do you have?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Product Design to lead the design charter for its B2C: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate (IT)
jobs.description:
**Role**: Business Development Executive (AI Services)

**Location**: Jaipur

**Type**: Full-time

**Experience**: 3 to 6 Years

**Reports To**: CEO / Management

**About**

Concretio 75-person AI and Salesforce consultancy based in Jaipur. Alongside our Salesforce practice, we build custom AI agents, LLM-powered systems, and intelligent automation for mid-market and enterprise clients across India and the US. This role sits inside our pure AI services practice, which operates independently of the Salesforce stack.

**The Role**

You hunt for companies that are ready to build AI but haven't found the right partner yet. Your prospects are CTOs sitting on a backlog of AI ideas they can't execute internally, COOs running manual processes that should have been automated two years ago, and product leaders who want to ship AI-powered features without hiring a full ML team.

The entry point for almost every deal is a proof of concept: a focused, time-boxed build that proves value before a large commitment. Your job is to find the right company, frame the right problem, and get them into that PoC conversation, and everything follows from there.

**What You Will Do**

* Build a tiered target account list monthly. Tier 1: companies actively posting AI Engineer, ML Engineer, or Head of AI roles. They have a budget and intent. Tier 2: companies that have publicly announced AI initiatives but haven't shipped. Tier 3: ICP-fit companies with no visible AI signal yet.

jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description:
**About the Client**

ValCera is running this search for a client in Digital Assets, an early-stage company with teams in the UAE. The client builds infrastructure and financial products for institutions on its own network. AI now runs across several of its lines of business, from verifiable compute to investment. This role brings all of it under one owner.

**The Role**

**One owner for AI**

The Head of AI sets the AI strategy and decides what moves first. That covers compute, investment, new AI products and internal tools.

The role needs range. It takes the technical depth to judge how AI workloads run and get verified on-chain, and the commercial judgment to defend an investment thesis to institutional investors. It also takes someone who can explain the company's AI position to builders, investors and clients in terms each can act on.

**What is actually unsolved**

Today the core network is live, and the zero-knowledge layer runs on testnet. Proving a model's output in zero knowledge still costs far more than running it. So the first call is which AI workloads to prove, and which need a cheaper route. On the investment side, the thesis is still to be built and defended. Nobody has a playbook for doing both inside one company yet.

**Responsibilities**

• Set the AI strategy and decide its sequence across compute, investment, products and internal tooling.

• Scope which AI workloads the zero-knowledge layer verifies, including inference and agents acting on-chain.

• Build the AI and deep tech investment thesis and shape the deals that follow from it.

• Own the roadmap for a new AI product built on the network.

• Make the case for the company's AI work to developers, institutional investors and enterprise buyers, in writing and on stage.

• Advise the leadership team on which AI tools each function should adopt.

**Requirements**

• Has built ML systems hands-on, then owned AI product or strategy decisions in a company.

• Has worked hands-on with verifiable compute or AI agent systems, enough to judge an architecture, not describe one.

• Has written for engineers and for institutional investors, and can show work for both.

**Nice to Have**

• Has backed or advised AI or deep tech companies, as an angel, a fund or an operator.

• Has presented an investment thesis to limited partners or an investment committee.

• Has spoken at AI or deep tech conferences.

**Culture**

The team works across time zones and meets in person regularly. The core protocol is open source, and the founder is an engineer. The trade-off is breadth. The company is building several products at once and staffing most functions in parallel. Much of what this role touches is pre-launch, so the early work is deciding what launches first.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
**About US:**
Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Currently headquartered in Saudi Arabia, Soar is growing throughout the region with a mission to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools through its multi-purpose platform, designed to offer a simple and seamless user experience.
  
**The Mission:**
Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth — trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work — sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing — with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define what that product is, build it from zero, and use it to fundamentally reinvent how real estate works. This is not a role for someone who wants to optimize an existing roadmap. It is for a builder who wants to create a category. What “agentic-first” means here
  
Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.
  
**What “agentic-first” means here:**

* Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way.
* work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.
* Agents as the core unit of the product, rather than features that wrap a model around old workflows.
* Outcomes over interfaces — the product should accomplish outcomes, not just surface information.
* Trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop by design — designing for the moments
* where the agent acts on the user’s behalf, and where the human stays in control.
* Data and feedback as a moat — a learning loop where every transaction makes the next one smarter.

**Requirements**
**What you’ll do:**

* Set the vision. Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic-first real estate platform — and the conviction behind it.
* Build 0 to 1, then 1 to n. Take products from blank page to launch to scale. Define the first wedge, ship fast, learn faster, and expand.
* Hire and lead the team. Recruit, lead, and grow a world-class product, design, and product-engineering culture from the ground up.
* Push the technology. Work hands-on with frontier models, agent frameworks, and emerging tooling. Run experiments others consider too early or too risky.
* Take real risks. Make bold, calculated bets with incomplete information — and own the outcomes, good or bad.
* Be a force across the company. Partner with engineering, design, GTM, and leadership to align the company behind a coherent product strategy.
* Stay obsessed with users. Talk to agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, and investors
* constantly. Translate the messy reality of real estate into products people love.

**Who you are:**

* A proven builder. You have built and shipped products that real people used, ideally including 0-to-1 work where you defined the problem, not just the solution.
* Creative and unconventional. You think from first principles, question defaults, and are energized by problems with no established playbook.
* Fluent in cutting-edge AI. You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, or applied AI in production— or you’ve gone deep enough to lead a team that does.
* Comfortable with calculated risk. You take bold action, decide with conviction under uncertainty, and treat smart failures as the cost of moving fast.
* Strategic and hands-on. You can set strategy and dive into the details — prototypes, specs, prompts, data, and metrics.
* A magnet for talent. You inspire great people to do the best work of their careers, and you raise the bar on everyone around you.
* High velocity. You move with urgency, communicate with clarity, and care more about impact than process.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience fintech, marketplaces, Agentic Applications, and AI Research and R&D space.
* Founder or early-stage operator experience.
* A technical background or the ability to go toe-to-toe with engineers on agent architecture.
* A portfolio of products, prototypes, or experiments we can see and play with.

**Why this role:**

* You will be a founding member of the leadership team, with the mandate and ownership to shape the product, the team, and the company. The market is enormous, the timing for agentic AI is now, and the upside — in impact and in equity — is real.
* If you want to build something that changes an entire industry, and you’re willing to bet boldly to do it, we should talk.

jobs.title: Head of Exchange Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine
* Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer
* Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot
* Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own
* Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them
* Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets
* Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it
* Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead
* Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

**What You Bring**

* Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms
* Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room
* Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them
* Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap
* Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces
* Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds
* Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
* A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

**Nice to haves**

* Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them
* Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each
* Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations
* Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*
*We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*
**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.
  
  
We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world's most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we turn

dreamers into doers and potential into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm — 220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**

Traders no longer just Google "best prop firm." They ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and AI decides which brands get named. It's a "define how NEXT Ventures gets found, cited and trusted — in Google and in AI answers — at scale" role. You'll own the full search function — strategy, infrastructure, team, and execution — and build it into a core growth engine for the business.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

**Build the Foundation**

* You've led a team or a cross-functional workstream and know how to get the best out of people.
* Fintech or trading experience is a genuine advantage — you understand the user, the stakes, and the compliance rules.

You don't wait for the playbook — in AI search, there isn't one yet. You test, measure, and share what you learn. When something's broken you fix it; when something's working you scale it. You treat GEO as an extension of strong SEO, not a replacement, and you'd rather

At NEXT Ventures, performance is more than numbers — it's the pulse that drives

innovation and impact. This is a rare opportunity to define how a financial brand wins in AI

search, backed by a business that moves fast and bets on people who take ownership.

Your next chapter begins here.

**Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory**

Dubai, UAE | Full-time, office-based | AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive | Start: as soon as possible

**About Dreevo**

Dreevo is building a new kind of service marketplace in the UAE: one place where customers can discover, book and trust the services they need. We are live in Dubai with 8 service categories, 75 services and more than 300 SKUs, giving customers access to over AED 12 million worth of services through our provider network and our own mobile EV operation. We partner with vehicle manufacturers and are expanding across the UAE and into other verticals.

We are still an early-stage company. Product, technology, operations, partnerships, brand and commercial models are being built in parallel, which gives Legal a direct hand in how the business is structured and scaled.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory to become Dreevo's first dedicated in-house legal hire.

Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Founder/Director and leadership team, you will take practical ownership of Dreevo's day-to-day corporate, commercial and regulatory legal matters.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded lawyer who is comfortable in a fast-moving environment. You will need to understand what the business is trying to achieve, identify the genuine legal and regulatory risks, recommend practical solutions, draft and negotiate agreements yourself, and decide when specialist external counsel is needed.

**Your First 90 Days**

- Redraft our service provider terms, customer terms and privacy policy, starting with how our marketplace contracting model should work.

- Finalise NDA and confidentiality documentation for upcoming partnerships.

- Put intercompany agreements in place across the Dreevo group.

- Support licensing and permits as we expand into new emirates.

- Register and protect the Dreevo brand and trademarks.

- Set up contract templates, a contract register and signing authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Commercial contracts***

- Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including NDAs, MoUs, heads of terms, service, supplier, procurement, technology, SaaS, API and development agreements.

- Support partnerships with vehicle manufacturers and energy, technology and institutional partners.

- Advise the CEO, Founder/Director and leadership team on new services, partnerships and operating models.

***Marketplace, consumer and data***

- Build the legal framework for service providers on the marketplace, covering onboarding, service levels, payments, insurance, liability, suspension and termination.

- Draft and maintain customer terms, refund and cancellation policies, privacy notices and marketplace disclosures in line with UAE consumer protection and e-commerce rules.

- Lead UAE PDPL compliance, including data processing agreements, data retention and cross-border data.

- Protect Dreevo's intellectual property, including source code, designs, data, AI workflows and brand assets, and review open source and AI licensing terms with Product and Engineering.

***Regulatory and corporate***

- Manage licensing, permits and activity requirements for the marketplace and new verticals, working with the RTA and other UAE and Dubai authorities.

- Advise on mainland and free zone structures and intercompany arrangements.

- Coordinate entity set-up, constitutional documents, shareholder and director records and UBO filings with corporate service providers.

- Support fundraising, investor due diligence and corporate transactions alongside external counsel.

***Employment and legal operations***

- Advise on UAE employment matters and prepare employment, contractor, consultancy, IP assignment and confidentiality documents.

- Manage disputes, claims and settlement discussions, and instruct and manage external counsel.

- Build Dreevo's legal operating framework: templates, approval processes, signing authorities, contract register and governance records.

**Required Experience**

- Qualified lawyer in a recognised jurisdiction.

- A minimum of 5 years' post-qualification experience.

- Strong UAE/GCC experience, with exposure to corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and regulatory matters.

- A track record of drafting and negotiating commercial and technology agreements through to signature.

- Experience in-house, on secondment or in a commercially focused law firm.

- A strong understanding of technology, data, intellectual property and digital platform contracts.

- The ability to run several workstreams independently and prioritise by commercial and legal risk.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain legal issues clearly and commercially.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in startups, scale-ups, marketplaces, mobility, automotive, logistics, energy, fintech, e-commerce or on-demand services would be particularly valuable.

Experience with marketplace agreements, SaaS and API licensing, data sharing, strategic partnerships, privacy, intellectual property, AI or open source matters is an advantage.

Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone commercially minded, practical and decisive. You should be comfortable giving clear recommendations rather than simply identifying legal issues, and confident enough to challenge senior leadership when necessary.

This is not a passive contract review role or a traditional company secretarial role. You will help create Dreevo's legal foundations from the beginning.

You will draft, negotiate, organise, build systems and solve problems yourself, while developing repeatable legal processes that can scale with the company.

**What We Offer**

- Salary of AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive

- UAE employment visa

- Medical insurance

- 24 working days' annual leave

- The chance to build Dreevo's legal function from the ground up

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of MarTech & Personalisation
jobs.description:
**Head of MarTech & Personalisation**
=====================================

The **Head of MarTech & Personalisation** makes sure every inDrive user sees the right service, offer and communication at the right moment - and, as a result, uses more of the app’s verticals, more often.

inDrive grew out of ride-hailing and is becoming a super app: rides, delivery, intercity, food, groceries and financial services. Most users still live in a single vertical. The SuperApp platform owns multi-vertical growth and frequency, and personalisation is its main lever; MarTech is the layer that makes personalisation run at scale.

The role sits in SuperApp Platform and reports to the Product Director. The Head defines the strategy for the domain, builds and leads a team, and is accountable for the impact of personalisation on multi-vertical growth.
  
  
It is a role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Data, with a clear split of ownership:

* **Owns:** the orchestration layer (which user sees what, where and when), personalisation of the main screen and cross-sell placements, the communications platform, the MarTech stack strategy, and the experimentation that proves impact.
* **Influences:** campaign content and promo budgets (Marketing), offer business rules (vertical and loyalty owners), ads inventory rules (Ads), predictive models (Data Science).

Department

SuperApp and Growth Businesses Product

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Address Abu Dhabi, Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Workplace type

Hybrid

Requisition ID

6911

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy:** Define the personalisation and MarTech strategy, from the user segments and intents we act on to which service, offer or message each user gets, where, and through which channel.
* **Build the orchestration layer:** Create one system that decides who sees what, where and when, with frequency caps to avoid overload. Offer and ads owners set their own rules. You own how those rules are combined and delivered.
* **Personalise the main screen and cross-sell:** Replace one-size-fits-all layouts with ones that adapt to each user, so more users try new verticals and use current ones more often.
* **Shape the MarTech stack:** Map current tools, set build-vs-buy criteria, and consolidate onto one platform, so teams launch communications without manual integrations.
* **Grow the communications platform:** Own triggered and segmented scenarios, channels (push, in-app, email, messengers), opt-outs and delivery quality.
* **Build and lead the team:** Grow a team focused on strong discovery, rigorous experimentation and outcomes over feature launches.

**What success looks like**

* Personalised surfaces and communications drive more multi-vertical users and higher order frequency.
* All offers and messages go through one orchestration layer, with proven lift and controlled communication load.
* Marketing and the verticals launch segmented communications without engineers.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **Product Experience:** 8+ years of product management experience in large-audience consumer products (Marketplace, Super App, E-commerce, FoodTech, or FinTech).
* **Leadership:** 3+ years leading and developing product managers.
* **Platform Products:** Proven track record of building scalable, platform-based product solutions in data-rich environments.
* **MarTech & Personalisation:** Deep expertise in MarTech ecosystems, personalisation, and customer data.
* **Strategy:** Strong ability to define product strategy and roadmap, and to turn business goals into product capabilities.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and data governance.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Experienced in leading alignment across Marketing, Tech, and Data teams and leadership.
* **Communication:** Business-fluent English proficiency (B2/C1+ or equivalent).

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
Senior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.
  
- Own and govern the technology change portfolio for one or more assigned Mashreq Groups, acting as the senior Transformation Office partner to Group leadership across investment planning, delivery governance, portfolio performance, value realization and forward forecasting.
  
- Provide an accurate, decision-oriented view of the portfolio from demand and budget formulation through initiation, execution, closure and benefits realization, maintaining a single source of truth and ensuring adherence to Mashreq project Methods.
  
- Act as a trusted advisor to Group Heads and senior stakeholders, proactively identifying portfolio risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and value leakage; drive resolution and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance forums.
  
- Provide Project Quality Assurance across the assigned portfolio and strengthen project-management capability by assuring PM competence and Method compliance, coaching and training project managers, and directly leading selected critical projects where required.
  
- Works with the respective Owners within Groups to ensure that all transformation initiatives are aligned with Mashreq's strategic goals and objectives, by providing active support and coordination during the budgeting, initiation and planning cycles,
  
- Fosters close collaboration with senior leadership to ensure buy-in support, and effective decision-making throughout the transformation journeys.
  
- Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,
  
- Acts as Initiation Lead, either directly or by identifying resources to hold this role, and coordinate the activities related to initiation, planning, estimations, articulations of the benefits and business case to be included in the request for budgets in the form of the Executive Summary.
  
- Review Executive Summaries, make best effort to check for completeness of the estimates and be one of the mandatory signatories,
  
- Monitors and reports on the transformation initiatives roadmap at the Mashreq and Group levels, and escalates concerns as necessary,
  
- Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,
  
- Defines and implements a communication strategy to regularly disseminate and communicate progress updates and outcomes of transformation initiatives to the right stakeholders, ensuring transparency,
  
- Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.
  
- Leads projects managers in the management of projects within the Portfolio. Assures that the execution of projects is done in accordance with Mashreq’s Methods.
  
- Provides training and knowledge transfer as required on TO approved ways of working.
  
- Contributes to the development of Mashreq’s Delivery Methods.
  
- Work towards continuously improving Mashreq’s delivery capabilities thus maximizing the opportunities for business value creation from transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key Result Areas: --
  
A. Portfolio Strategy, Demand & Investment Planning

- Apply agreed prioritization criteria and advise Group leadership on investment trade-offs, capacity constraints, synergies and sequencing.
  
  
B. Portfolio Execution, Control & Reporting
  
- Maintain an accurate portfolio inventory and single source of truth, clearly distinguishing projects not yet initiated, initiated/in planning, in execution, live/delivered, on hold and closed.

- Provide timely and accurate inputs into bank-wide Technology Projects reporting, ensuring consistent definitions, data quality and traceability across Groups.

C. Delivery Assurance & Mashreq Methods
  
  
- Act as Project Quality Assurance lead for assigned Groups, performing structured health checks against Mashreq project Methods, governance standards, mandatory artefacts and control gates.
  
- Assess whether project plans and baselines are credible, governance is operating effectively, RAID items and dependencies are actively managed, and executive decisions are captured and actioned.

E. Benefits & Value Realization

F. Project Manager Leadership & Capability

jobs.title: Associate Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
The role supports the timely and accurate forecasting of ~900 nostro accounts across 10 centres, spanning intragroup accounts, 3rd party agents and central banks (totalling ~$500bn in managed liquidity per day). This is done in close partnership with funding and trading desks across Treasury and FX, and requires regular engagements with other teams across the bank. Finally, the role involves oversight for the banks throughput and intraday liquidity management at central banks. This footprint will expand as we onboard another 33 centres spanning ~1000 nostros and central banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Be responsible and accountable for real time nostro management processes:**

* Team management / oversight to ensure the successful delivery of day-to-day forecasting, intraday liquidity (IDL) and cash management functions.
* Calculation and provision of funding forecasts to Treasury Markets and FX desks in line with agreed cutoffs on an intraday basis. Provision of root cause analysis on key funding drivers and forecast swings.
* Intraday liquidity monitoring and management of the firm’s central bank accounts
* Proactive management of payment scheduling systems to ensure the firm’s throughput requirements as well as time critical payments are met
* Drive strategies linked to forecasting and IDL related optimization
* Connect with global transformational programmes to ensure seamless operations
* Partner with the TS MT to further enhance and build on the teams Target Operating Model.
* Be a key business partner and support contact to Treasury Markets to ensure effective real time funding and liquidity management decision-making.
* Oversee cash management processes to manage IDL and funding
* Oversee real time forecasting and IDL related KRIs / dashboards for close monitoring and escalation on an intraday basis,
* Provision of Nostro MI in terms of next day balance reporting / explanations, monthly cost management, balance trends / root causes

**Risk Management**

* Ensure 100% compliance at all times to the group’s risk management framework as applicable

**Governance**

* Comply with all the group standards, policies, procedures and guidelines as applicable and values of the Bank at all times.
* Adhere to Group Code of Conduct at all times.
* Ensure compliance to the group’s risk management framework as applicable.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Treasury, Financial Markets, Country Financial Markets Operations, Group Financial Markets Operations, Finance, Country CIO

**Skills And Experience**

* Good verbal & written English communication
* Excellent analytical capabilities
* Proficient in PC skills, particularly MS Office
* Strong people management skills.
* Strong leadership qualities and interpersonal skills
* Prioritization and Delegation of activities
* Problem solving / Trouble shooting skills
* Ability to identify, mitigate and eliminate risks in processes.
* Expert knowledge of forecasting, IDL and cash management functions and processes (funding driver and variance explains, payment scheduling/throughput, cash sweeps)
* Strong knowledge of Central Bank, Nostros, Vostros
* Good knowledge in IDL and related areas - systems and processes linked to IDL management and optimization, peak usage, stress metrics and associated HQLA buffers
* Good knowledge in front to back flows, particularly related to payments and settlements across asset classes is useful
* Good knowledge of MT / ISO payment and statement related messages (PACS, CAMT, MT9x, MT5x)

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 10 years relevant experience in any Banking operations
* Minimum 2 years’ experience of funding and liquidity management
* Prior experience in business facing support functions - particularly Treasury and/or FX
* Prior people manager experience
* Prior experience in building out teams, operating models and supporting strategic change / delivery
* Prior experience in Payments, Settlements / Confirmations (Securities, FX, Rates etc) is useful

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Since 2007 Morgan Stanley has been expanding its own fully owned premier investment banking and sales & trading platform in India, providing a full range of investment banking, sales & trading, equity, fixed income, commodities and derivative products, as well as research services. Building on this existing platform in India, we are looking to invest in establishing a Derivative Operations division that will continue to recognize and match the global need of our clients.

  
  

**Background on the Team**

  

The Equity Confirmation Operations team is responsible for preparing, reviewing, and finalizing trade confirmations for equity products such as equity derivatives, options, swaps and structured equity transactions. The team ensures that all trade details agreed upon between Morgan Stanley and the counterparty(s) are accurately documented and compliant with internal policies, market regulations and legal standards.

This position focuses on modernizing the equity trade confirmations workflow enabling robust control framework, timely dispatch of confirmations to counterparties and increasing process efficiency.

  

The functional ops teams’ responsibilities include:

* Drafting and issuing trade confirmations based on executed deals
* Verifying trade terms with traders, sales teams and operations

This is a critical leadership role responsible for driving strategic change initiatives across the Equity Confirms Ops Group under the Derivations Operations umbrella. This role combines strategic oversight, financial and operational performance monitoring, business planning, regulatory and risk management, and cross-functional coordination to support the business head and leadership team. **Governance & Controls**

* Coordinate operational reviews and consolidate business reporting.

* Ensure documentation meets enterprise requirements and is refreshed on defined cycles.

**People & Engagement Support**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.

* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

Unlock your potential to shape valuation rigor and reporting that improves controls, transparency, and investment decision-making across private markets.

* Ability to simplify complex topics for CFO / CTO-level stakeholders
* Ability to drive accountability across multiple parties

Keep global markets moving by leading critical payments foreign exchange operations during European business hours from Mumbai. This is a high-impact opportunity to partner with operations, product, technology, front office, and control teams to deliver resilient outcomes. You will set the standard for resilient execution, own incident command for the region, and partner with product, technology, front office, and controls to manage risk and raise service quality. jobs.description:

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.title: Sr Director, Finance
jobs.description:
**About Data Axle**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission-critical data services to its global customers, powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.  
  
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements under both IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage accounting differences between Indian and US reporting frameworks, including revenue recognition, leases, fixed assets, provisions, and foreign currency transactions.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment of accounting practices and reporting standards.
* Drive implementation of changes in accounting standards and assess their business impact.

* **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Develop financial models, business forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Partner with business leaders to identify cost optimization and profitability improvement opportunities.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Lead statutory, internal, and external audit processes.
* Manage coordination with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, including corporate tax, GST, transfer pricing, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to Indian statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support US audit and tax reporting requirements in coordination with global finance teams.

* **Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee treasury operations, working capital, liquidity, and cash flow management.
* Develop strategies for efficient cash utilization and financial risk management.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Manage banking relationships and financing arrangements.

* **Global Finance Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
* Build a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and digital transformation across finance operations.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for the finance function.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 15+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in Finance and Accounting, including significant experience in senior finance leadership roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in both **IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP**.
* Proven experience managing financial reporting and controllership for multinational organizations or US-headquartered companies.
* Strong understanding of US GAAP technical accounting, financial consolidation, and statutory reporting.
* Experience managing global finance stakeholders and cross-border financial operations.
* Strong exposure to financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, treasury, and audit management.
* Experience leading large finance teams and managing complex financial operations.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
