jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Strategy**
This role encompasses:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.
* Lead analysis and recommendations on Visa Direct pricing, incentives and IRF changes, and support M&A, investment and partnership opportunities with due diligence and business cases.
* Scan market, regulatory and ecosystem trends (e.g. real-time payments, stablecoins, fintech disruption) and provide insights on impact to strategy and key initiatives; coordinate with the VCS BPO Director on topics spanning CMS.

**Business Planning & Performance**

* With Finance and key business partners, lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and multi-year outlook, target setting, OKR planning and review, scorecards and business reviews; track quarterly Opex and investment.
* Maintain one consolidated view of revenue, net revenue, AANR and other KPIs, flag gaps and risks early, and reuse CMS Data, Analytics & AI and global dashboards rather than duplicating reporting.
* Drive AANR-to-net-revenue conversion by tracking signed agreements through launch to live volume; run pipeline and AANR governance with sub-regional sales leaders and shape priority deal strategy with CMS Deals Management.

**Sales And Account Management Excellence**

* Support the sales and account management center of excellence (COE): manage sales and implementation pipelines, share sales goals with partnering client segment units and define the optimal client coverage model.
* Plan sales targets in line with the AOP; provide inputs to incentive design (SIP) and recognition programs; monitor team performance against targets.
* Optimize sales processes, tools (MS Dynamics) and funding programs (e.g. VIK, MDF), with training to improve the team's skills.
* Orchestrate account planning to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and drive the annual Global Client Engagement Survey (GCES) and corrective actions.

**Communications**

* Maintain internal communications (all-hands, newsletters) and share success stories across the CEMEA Money Movement organization.
* Lead materials for key cadences (MBRs, QBRs, all-staffs, Global and CEMEA LT sessions, client councils) and run the leadership operating rhythm with clear agendas, decisions and actions.
* Liaise with Global Money Movement, Investor Relations and Communications for Visa CEO, CFO, President and investment community forums.

**Execution**

* As a strategic partner to the CEMEA CMS head of BPO and head of Money Movement, organize and prioritize critical information and data for efficient decision-making and manage time-sensitive senior requests.
* Deliver strategic initiatives, from spinning up cross-functional teams to deal due diligence, and build the program management function to drive execution of key CEMEA Money Movement initiatives.
* Coordinate planning cycles with Global Visa Direct and Global CMS BPO, bring global best practice to the region and reuse CMS BPO and Centers of Excellence capabilities rather than rebuilding them.
* Work as one team with the other CMS functional BPOs and CoE to share best practices from Visa Direct with the wider team

This role sits at the intersection of multiple functions, so organizational savvy and interpersonal skills are critical. It works with Product groups, AEs, Merchant Sales, Regions, Operations, Technology, Risk, Data Science, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Corporate Strategy, Interchange/Pricing and Finance. About 60% of the role is the recurring operating rhythm (planning, OKRs, MBR/QBR, pipeline and performance reviews, Opex) and 40% strategic, project and ad-hoc work. The individual will be a thought leader in strategy and business growth with a proven track record in fast-paced environments with demanding timelines.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, MD, PhD).
* Prior experience in management consulting or corporate strategy.
* Proven track record in annual and multi-year planning, OKRs and executive business reviews; strong financial acumen, including business cases and financial modeling.
* Financial/payment industry knowledge mandatory (money movement, cross-border flows); experience across emerging, multi-country markets such as CEMEA.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, customer-centric mindset and thought leadership, with evidence of tangible business results.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills; able to explain complex concepts to broad audiences and lead cross-functional teams to obtain buy-in.
* Strong sense of urgency and experience driving to successful commercialization; takes prompt, decisive action after analyzing relevant information.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
* Experience leading and developing people; inclusive, learning-agile, with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a technology / digital-first approach; English required, Arabic, Russian or French an advantage.
* High levels of learning-agility with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a ‘technology / digital-first’ approach.
* Diversity of thought and experience. Continually seeks new perspectives and feedback, takes an inclusive approach, and engages diverse points of view.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward

jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers

* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

jobs.title: Account Director, Private Sector (MEA & Turkey)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.
  
  
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
  
  
TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across MEAT. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Open new private sector accounts across the MEAT region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.
* Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.
* Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.
* Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.
* Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.
* Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in MEAT, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.
* A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.
* Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.
* Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.
* Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.
* Fluent English, other relevant languages including Arabic, Turkish, French a bonus
* Based in Dubai and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

**About The Team**

* TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.
* The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.
* The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.
* You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

**Learn About TRM Speed In This Position**

* Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.
* When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.
* Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

**Team Operating Rhythms**

* Distributed, not distant: the team works across Gulf time, and occasional US calls on complex deals.
* Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.
* Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.
* Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

**Required Online And Collaboration Hours**

* Schedule: Core hours overlapping Gulf Time, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

**Application Instructions**
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
  
  
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
  
  
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
  
  
**Interviewing with TRM**
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
  
  

* Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
  
  
**AI Fluency at TRM**
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
  
  
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
  
  
At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To
  
  

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
  
  
**Life at TRM**
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
  
  
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
  
  
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
  
  
**At TRM, You Should Expect**

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. **About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Institutional Lending Officer, you will play a critical role in partnering with key business stakeholders, including Relationship Credit and Relationship Management teams, to deliver timely, efficient, and customer-focused lending and collateral management solutions.

  

The role is responsible for the setup, maintenance, and ongoing management of lending facilities across core banking platforms such as Loan IQ, Orion, and Razor, ensuring accurate processing, data integrity, and operational excellence. Additionally, you will support the delivery of optimized customer outcomes by effectively managing facility administration and collateral-related activities throughout the lending lifecycle.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**Role Location:**  
Bangalore  
**Work Schedule:**  
Early morning shift(5 AM login)

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Institutional Lending Officer, you will be responsible for :

  

* Managing lending facilities end-to-end, including the accurate setup, maintenance, renewal, and processing of loan drawdowns, repayments, and related documentation across core systems such as Loan IQ, Orion, and Razor.

* Monitoring and maintaining loan documentation, following up on outstanding requirements, and ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance throughout the lending lifecycle.
* Driving the timely collection of fees and interest while maintaining accurate records and ensuring all activities are appropriately reflected in workflow management tools and operational systems.
* Partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Credit teams, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional customer outcomes and provide proactive support on lending and collateral management matters.
* Acting as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders by responding to queries promptly, providing status updates, and escalating risks, issues, or customer concerns where necessary.
* Identifying opportunities for process improvement and risk mitigation, and recommending practical solutions to enhance operational efficiency, controls, and the overall customer experience.
* Contributing to a collaborative and compliant work environment by supporting projects, adhering to established policies and procedures, maintaining required accreditations, and ensuring business continuity readiness.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* 8+ years of experience in Banking Operations, Lending Services, or Institutional Banking, with strong hands-on expertise in Loan IQ and lending operations, along with exposure to platforms such as Orion, Razor, and CACHE, or the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems and processes.

* Excellent organizational, coordination, and analytical problem-solving capabilities, supported by a proactive, self-driven approach to operational excellence.

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

  

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enabl

* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.

* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.
* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.
* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

Inc42 is looking for a Sales Manager – Events & IPs to drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across its events, conferences, communities and proprietary intellectual properties.

The role will focus on acquiring new brand partners, identifying sponsorship opportunities and building customised partnership proposals for companies looking to engage with India's startup and business ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in B2B sales and business development, with experience selling sponsorships, event partnerships, advertising solutions or other high-value B2B offerings. They should be comfortable pitching to marketing heads, founders, CXOs and senior decision-makers, and have the ability to take ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably across events, media, publishing, experiential marketing agencies, advertising agencies or consulting firms. Front-end experience of selling to startups, technology companies and/or BFSI companies is mandatory.

### **Why This Role Is Unique**

**Impact:** Inc42's platforms collectively reach more than 300 Mn people online and have brought together over 50,000 attendees and 1,000 speakers. You will be responsible for building commercial partnerships across some of India's most influential startup and business events.

**Inc42 Network:** Engage directly with founders, CXOs, marketing leaders, investors and decision-makers across startups, enterprises,and consulting firms.

**Build Strategic Partnerships:** Work with brands to create meaningful associations with Inc42's platforms through sponsorships, event integrations, customised experiences and long-term partnerships.

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.

* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.

* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities.
  
  
As we evolve our Product Engineering organization toward stronger end-to-end Build & Run accountability, we are looking for a Director – Product Engineering Capability to build and sustain the functional, domain and specialist capabilities required across the Advantage portfolio.
  
  
The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness
  
  

* Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements.
* Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs.

Role & Competency Model
  
  

* Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles.
* Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization.
* Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise.

* Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage.
* Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets.
* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

Transformation & Future Skills
  
  

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.
* Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness.
* Create mechanisms for rapidly developing and scaling new capabilities as technology and market needs evolve.

Partnership with Product Engineering
  
  

* Partner closely with Product Engineering Directors to understand capability demand and delivery challenges.
* Ensure capability development remains grounded in real Product Engineering outcomes rather than becoming a centralized or theoretical function.
* Support product organizations with the right specialist capability while avoiding unnecessary organizational hand-offs or approval layers.
* Provide transparent visibility into capability health, gaps, risks and readiness.

Capability Measurement
  
  

* Establish a capability health framework and measurable indicators.
* Track areas such as critical-role coverage, proficiency maturity, succession readiness, capability-gap closure, specialist availability, mobility and reduction in key-person dependencies.
* Demonstrate tangible impact of capability initiatives on engineering quality, productivity and organizational effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**

* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, cloud modernization, AI-enabled engineering and contemporary product-development practices strongly preferred.
* ERP, government solutions or large mission-critical enterprise-platform experience would be advantageous, but is not mandatory.

Good to have skills:

jobs.description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Client Insights & Solutions (CIS) team develops actionable insights and solutions that help priority Institutional clients achieve their strategic objectives and manage challenges. The team supports ANZ Institutional to originate higher-returning transactions, improve cross-sell and deepen senior client engagement, and to differentiate ANZ as a leading relationship bank.
  
  
The Lead Associate is a senior member of the Bengaluru CIS team with team leadership responsibilities. The role leads complex client analyses and initiatives, acts as a subject matter expert in capital structure, liquidity, M&A, credit and risk management, and manages, mentors and develops Senior Associates (Group 4.4) and Associates (Group 5.1) in the team.
  
  
The Lead Associate works closely with the Head of CIS Bengaluru, the onshore CIS teams and senior stakeholders, relationship bankers and product partners to deliver the broader goals of the CIS team.
  
  
The role contributes to ANZ 2030 priorities: customer-first propositions, simplicity and productivity, resilience and strong risk management, and higher-returning growth. It does this through high-quality, insight-led work for Institutional clients, efficient delivery through the global operating model, building team capability, and strong quality and risk discipline
  
  
Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Lead Customer Insights Associate, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Lead financial, credit and industry analysis for priority Institutional clients, including capital structure optimisation, M&A assessment, credit analysis, financial modelling, working capital reviews and sector research.
* Translate complex data into clear, client-ready insights that support origination, cross-sell opportunities and senior client engagement.
* Review financial models and client materials to ensure accuracy, quality and relevance.
* Develop client presentations and industry campaigns that support relationship banking and product teams.Partner with Relationship
* Bankers, Product Specialists and onshore CIS teams to understand client needs, define deliverables and drive outcomes.
* Maintain effective stakeholder communication and proactively manage timelines and priorities.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives across Relationship, Product and Business Execution teams.
* Incorporate stakeholder feedback to continuously improve deliverables and client value.
* Mentor and coach Analysts and Senior Analysts, supporting project delivery and professional development.
* Review team outputs to ensure high-quality, client-ready standards.
* Promote collaboration, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across Bengaluru and onshore teams.
* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities and analytical tool enhancements.
* Support a strong risk and compliance culture by adhering to ANZ policies and identifying and mitigating risks

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* 8+ years in a similar or related role, preferably in Institutional Banking or Financial Services
* Experience managing, mentoring or supervising analysts or associates, through direct line management or project-based team leadership
* Capital structuring, risk assessment and credit-rating or shadow rating experience (S&P Global, Moody's, Fitch methodologies)
* Exposure to Debt Capital Markets and risk management products, including advising on FX, interest rate and commodity price risk
* Preparation of pitch books, client presentations, credit papers or research reports; supporting relationship bankers and onshore or cross-border teams
* Data analysis, visualization or process automation, and experience with financial databases and research platforms
* Industry qualifications (e.g. CFA) are highly regarded
* Leadership capability, including coaching, quality review and managing work to successful outcomes
* Structured, evidence-based approach, with attention to detail and ownership of output quality

**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 128715

Resource management associate will operate as the day-to-day staffing and workforce planning coordinator for Life Sciences. The role requires strong verbal and written communication, self-direction, comfort working with stakeholders from consultants through Partners/Directors, strong data-analysis skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent requests with accuracy and follow-through. The individual should be technology proficient, able to learn new systems quickly, and able to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with U.S. East Coast mornings and, when needed, UK stakeholders.

The Resource Management associate will help maintain an accurate, forward-looking view of staff availability and project demand, coordinate staffing changes, and support practice leadership with the data and follow-through needed to make timely staffing decisions. The role works closely with project managers, service-line leads, people managers, and practice leadership to balance project needs, employee skills and availability, utilization, and project economics.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

* Own day-to-day staffing coordination and serve as a central point of contact for project staffing requests, extensions, releases, holds, and schedule changes.
* Maintain accurate staffing plans and workplans in ProjectHub and related resource-management systems, including start/end dates, allocations, extensions, and temporary availability.
* Proactively follow up with project managers to confirm staffing plans, close outstanding requests, and ensure requested changes are completed and communicated.
* Monitor current and near-term staff availability, including partial availability and upcoming roll-offs, and identify potential staffing conflicts, over-allocation, underutilization, and opportunities to redeploy capacity.
* Match staffing needs with available resources based on skills, experience, availability, development interests, and project requirements; coordinate with project and service-line leaders when tradeoffs or conflicts require decisions.
* Support weekly staffing discussions by preparing the underlying data, tracking open needs and decisions, maintaining notes/action items, and following through on agreed staffing updates.
* Analyze staffing, utilization, scheduled hours, project budgets, and related financial data to identify exceptions and actionable insights for leadership.
* Support project financial and capacity-management activities, including monitoring scheduled versus budgeted hours, identifying excess or remaining hours, flagging potential over/under-budget conditions, and helping ensure staffing changes are reflected accurately in systems.
* Coordinate with project teams on special project setup and revenue/staffing requirements where standard scheduling does not fully capture the engagement model.
* Maintain high data quality across staffing tools and reports by cross-checking requests against current project and availability information before making changes.
* Adapt to evolving staffing processes and tools, including changes to ProjectHub, Engagement Hub, forecasting, and other firm resource-management systems.

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree required.
* 3+ years of relevant work experience preferred, including experience in resource management, staffing operations, project management, consulting operations, workforce planning, or a similarly fast-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal, customer-service, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to work effectively across organizational levels.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to follow up persistently and professionally with busy stakeholders and close the loop on open actions.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret staffing, utilization, capacity, and project financial data and translate it into clear actions.
* Highly organized and self-motivated; able to prioritize and execute numerous concurrent staffing requests and recurring processes with limited supervision.
* Strong proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office, including manipulating and analyzing spreadsheets; demonstrated ability to learn new enterprise systems quickly.
* Experience with staffing, workforce-planning, project-management, ERP, or forecasting systems is strongly preferred.
* Ability to build trusted working relationships with project managers, practice leadership, people managers, and consultants while balancing business needs and employee considerations.
* Ability to work hours that overlap with U.S. East Coast mornings; flexibility to coordinate across U.S., UK, and India time zones as business needs require.

jobs.title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Industry:** Engineering Consulting / Manufacturing / Project Management Company / EPC

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Account Manager** with at least **3 years** of experience in managing banking operations, personal accounting, and international trade (import/export). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in **Bank Guarantees**, **Personal Accounting**, and **Import & Export documentation and compliance**. You will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and acting as the liaison between internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**1. Bank Guarantees & Financial Instruments**

* Manage the full lifecycle of **Bank Guarantees** (issuance, renewal, cancellation).
* Work closely with banks to handle **Letters of Credit (LCs)**, **Standby LCs**, and **foreign remittance processes**.
* Ensure all financial instruments are in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

**Educational Qualification:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance or any related field.

**Office Timing:**  
10:30 AM to 7:30 PM / Flexible timing (Second and Fourth Saturday Off)

**Office Location:**  
Lower Parel West, Mumbai 400013

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

**Vice President**

within an expanding and dynamic team, you will lead high-profile regulatory advisory engagements while building and maintaining strong client relationships across the financial services sector. You will be responsible for the delivery of complex projects, development of junior team members, and the continued growth of the practice through thought leadership and business development activities.
  
  
**As a Vice President, You Will**

* Drive business development activities, including proposal development, client presentations, thought leadership, networking, and market outreach.

**You Will Lead a Wide Range Of Engagements, Including**

* Skilled Person Reviews
* Risk and Compliance Health Checks

* Regulatory Assurance Reviews
* Regulatory Readiness Assessments
* Enterprise Risk Management Reviews
* Operational Risk Framework Development
* Controls Testing and Assurance
* AML / Financial Crime Compliance Reviews
* Regulatory Reporting Reviews
* Consumer Protection and Conduct Risk Reviews
* Governance Reviews
* Regulatory Gap Assessments
* Internal Audit and Second-Line Risk & Compliance Reviews

**The Ideal Candidate**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who is passionate about helping clients navigate an increasingly complex regulatory environment. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong client management and business development capabilities.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Law, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of relevant experience within a regulator, financial institution, consulting firm, or professional services organization.

* Strong knowledge of banking and financial services regulations and industry practices.
* Significant exposure to UAE-regulated financial institutions and UAE regulatory frameworks.
* Experience working within a Big 4, Big 6, or leading advisory firm is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to manage senior client stakeholders and lead complex engagements.
* Strong business development track record, including proposal writing, client acquisition, and revenue generation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic is advantageous.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
* Prior experience in one or more of the following areas:

+ Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Financial Crime
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Operational Risk
+ Regulatory Compliance
+ Internal Audit and Controls Assurance
+ Regulatory Change and Transformation Programs

**Professional Qualifications**
Professional certifications are highly desirable, including:
  
  

* International Compliance Association (ICA)
* Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment (CISI)
* ACAMS
* CFA, FRM, CIA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualifications

**About Kroll**

**One Team, One Kroll**
, you’ll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment while helping clients build, protect, restore, and maximize value.

Gulf Compliance Solutions (GCS) is a Dubai-based regulatory compliance specialist consultancy for financial services firms setting up in, expanding into, or operating in the UAE. We work with banks, investment managers and advisers, insurers, brokers, fintechs and virtual asset service providers across the DIFC, the ADGM, Dubai (VARA) and the UAE mainland (CBUAE).

We support clients at every stage, from first discussions and licensing strategy through launch and ongoing monitoring. Our services include:

* licensing and authorisation with the DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE
* outsourced Compliance Officers and MLROs
* AML/CTF programmes
* structuring advisory
* support on regulatory documentation, training, governance, accounting, tax and data protection

GCS is a founding member of Compliance Network International, an association of independent compliance firms in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore and India.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, hybrid Director role based in Dubai, combining time in our office with the flexibility to work from home.

You will lead client engagements and internal teams across regulatory licensing projects, compliance frameworks and ongoing advisory mandates for financial services and virtual asset firms. You will:

* Develop licensing strategies and guide clients through DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE application processes
* Review and sign off regulatory business plans, application documents and compliance documentation
* Advise clients on AML/CTF programmes, governance structures, risk-based compliance and remediation
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regulators and key stakeholders
* Coach and mentor team members and oversee the quality of their work
* Contribute to business development and help shape the firm’s services and market positioning
