jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. **About the Role**

We are seeking an Associate Director, Patient Safety Medical Writing to join our team in **Bengaluru**/**Hyderabad** in a **hybrid / on-site** capacity. As an Associate Director, Patient Safety Medical Writing, you will provide strategic direction and executive oversight across regional Safety Services, ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and alignment with organizational objectives. This position plays a key role in patient safety oversight, pharmacovigilance (PV) operations, and technology-driven safety innovation that supports clinical research and advances new treatments for patients.

Responsibilities include setting regional strategy and resource allocation, ensuring quality and regulatory compliance, leading people development and PV automation initiatives, and supporting client and business development, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence safety service outcomes.

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic leadership, pharmacovigilance automation and digital transformation, and client partnership. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Director, Patient Safety can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive strategic direction and resource allocation for regional Safety Services in partnership with the Senior Director, and provide input into business plans, budgets, growth strategies, and global expansion.
* Align Safety Services with global organizational strategy, lead continuous improvement of regional processes and procedures, and collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure harmonized global pharmacovigilance operations.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring:**

* Strengths in deep clinical, regulatory, and medical expertise, strategic leadership, and stakeholder management
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, with excellent negotiation skills
* An adaptable mindset, enthusiasm for learning, and a patient-focused approach
* Comfort working with pharmacovigilance automation and AI tools, digital safety solutions, and multi-region PV processes

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in Safety Services, including demonstrated success in clinical, medical, or scientific domains and substantial senior-level clinical experience with progressive responsibilities
* Proven people management experience, including leading high-performing teams in professional services environments
* Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance operations, clinical research methodologies, drug development processes, and global regulatory frameworks, with an excellent understanding of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH), Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences (CIOMS), and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) requirements, including Safety Quality standards
* Experience with automation and AI in pharmacovigilance
* Established history of successful business development and client relationship management
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1761887

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Description**

**Executive Director** - Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead, Finance Managed Services

**Portfolio** Finance Managed Services

**Primary focus** Enterprise transition strategy, deal shaping, mobilization assurance and transition innovation

**Location -** India GDS Location

  

**Position Summary**

The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.

The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.

  

**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide domain authority across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Financial Planning and Analysis, tax, treasury and controllership transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution.
* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Finance Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.
* Create reusable transition assets, reference architectures, control frameworks, benchmarks and AI-enabled techniques that improve quality, speed, predictability and margin across the wider Finance Managed Services business.
* Represent EY’s transition proposition with senior client executives during orals, negotiations, governance forums and critical mobilization decisions.

  

**Essential Functions of the Job**

* **Strategic deal shaping and client leadership**
  + Translate the client finance strategy, target operating model and retained-finance responsibilities into an executable transition solution, including service boundaries, controls, data, systems, governance and acceptance criteria.
  + Engage credibly with CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers and process owners on financial close, reporting, compliance, working capital and service-performance outcomes.
  + Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
  + Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.
  + Advise client C-suite and senior EY leaders on transition feasibility, sequencing, risk exposure, investment choices and trade-offs, particularly where requirements are incomplete or competing objectives cannot all be achieved.
  + Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* **Transition solution design & execution assurance**
  + Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.
  + Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
  + Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
  + Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
  + Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
  + Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

* **Functional authority and innovation**

jobs.title: Origination Director – Trade Finance & Working Capital
jobs.description:

You’ll be expected to personally bring in clients and close deals, and help to shape Finverity’s growth across key markets. This is a high-impact, front-line role for someone who knows how to win trust, structure deals, and deliver results.

**What You’ll Do**

**Own the Pipeline**

* Personally originate high-quality trade finance deals with mid-market corporates.
* Leverage your existing network to bring in new business quickly.
* Identify, engage, and build consensus with decision-makers in the prospect organisations.
* Prioritise speed-to-mandate with a strong commercial close rate.

**Close and Collaborate**

* Own the deals all the way through to the funding stage, including speaking to relevant funders in the Finverity ecosystem when appropriate.
* Collaborate with other members of the Finverity Capital team and cross-functionally with risk, legal, marketing and operations teams to ensure frictionless execution.

**Shape the Go-To-Market Strategy**

* Help refine Finverity’s go-to-market approach for the MENA region & beyond.
* Identify new industries, products, and market segments to accelerate growth.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships that feed the pipeline.
* Work with the marketing team to build out and execute marketing campaigns.
* Represent Finverity in client meetings and relevant conferences.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who knows how to bring in deals and who truly understands the dynamics of working capital and trade finance in the MENA region, especially in the UAE.   **5+ years**

  **excelled in customer-facing roles selling to CFOs and Treasurers,**

  **deep understanding of the working capital challenges**

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.description:
**Ready to shape Islamic finance growth across the MENAT region?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

Working as a subject matter expert, you’ll support business growth through transaction origination, structuring, execution and Shariah governance. You’ll partner with relationship managers and product teams to deliver Shariah-compliant financing solutions that meet client needs while maintaining regulatory, risk and control standards. The role also covers launching new Islamic products across the CIB platform, from due diligence through to implementation. Success means delivering scalable Islamic structures, progressing opportunities from concept to closing and supporting consistent practices across jurisdictions. jobs.title: Services Analytics Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Services Analytics Team Leader**
==================================

You will lead analytics for the **Services** cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas: **Watchdocs** (driver document verification and work with the compliance base), **Trust & Safety** (everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features), **Customer Support** (both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents' performance), **Customer Experience** (Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and **Antifraud** (protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).

  

You will build and manage a team that partners closely with **product, operations, support, and compliance** to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.

  

In this role, you will act as a **strategic partner** to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.

  

Department

Analytics Department

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Workplace type

Fully remote

Requisition ID

1635

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the **analytics strategy and roadmap** for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
* Build, grow, and develop a **team of 11+** (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
* Lead **Antifraud analytics**: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
* Drive **Trust & Safety analytics**: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
* Oversee **Customer Support analytics**: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance
* Lead **CX analytics**: connect Voice-of-the-Customer metrics (CSAT/DSAT) to business outcomes such as retention and revenue, and turn feedback into prioritized product and operational actions
* Guide **Watchdocs analytics**: the document-verification funnel, compliance coverage, and the balance between compliance rigor and a smooth driver onboarding experience
* Define and **standardize metrics, definitions, and monitoring** across the cluster; ensure data quality in partnership with DWH, DS, and Engineering
* Establish best practices in **experimentation (A/B testing), causal inference, forecasting, and effect measurement** across the team
* Partner cross-functionally at the **company level** (Product & Tech & Business, DWH, DS, Engineering) and act as a trusted advisor to Head / Director / C-suite stakeholders

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in data or product analytics, preferably in tech, ride-hailing, marketplace, or platform businesses
* 2+ years of people management, leading teams of 10+ people, including other managers or team leads
* Strong expertise in SQL and Python (or R), with a solid foundation in statistics and experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference)
* Proven ability to translate large volumes of behavioral, operational, and feedback data into decisions that balance risk, cost, and user experience
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders (Head / Director / C-suite) and forming and defending strategy at the company level
* Proficiency in BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Redash, or similar)
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Proven experience working on global products serving international audiences is required
* English: Professional Working Proficiency

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience in one of the Services domains — Trust & Safety, Antifraud, Customer Support / WFM, CX / Voice-of-the-Customer, or compliance
* Experience with fraud / risk modeling, anomaly detection, or safety analytics
* Familiarity with text / sentiment analysis for customer-feedback data
* Experience scaling analytics across multiple countries and verticals

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

**About Cilicant :** Cilicant Private Limited is a leading Indian manufacturer of active packaging solutions, specializing in desiccants, oxygen absorbers, molecular sieves and other packaging solutions that help preserve product quality and extend shelf life. With a strong presence in the pharmaceutical industry, Cilicant is now further expanding its business in the Food segment.

  

**Role Overview:** We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Business Development Professional to drive new business development for our Food Division. The individual will be responsible for identifying potential customers, developing new accounts and generating business for Cilicant's active packaging solutions, particularly oxygen absorbers and desiccants.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the food industry, established relationships with relevant customers and the ability to independently identify and convert new business opportunities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. New Business Development

* Identify and acquire new customers across food segments such as Bakery, FMCG, Snacks, Dry Fruits, Sweets & Confectionery, Pet Food, Spices and other packaged food categories.
* Leverage existing industry contacts and customer relationships to generate business opportunities.
* Develop and execute strategies to expand Cilicant's presence in the food packaging market.
* Generate leads, conduct customer meetings, make product presentations and convert prospects into customers.

2. Customer Relationship Management

* Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers in Packaging, Procurement, R&D, Quality and Production functions.
* Understand customer packaging requirements, product shelf-life challenges and application needs.
* Work closely with internal technical and R&D teams to propose suitable packaging solutions.
* Maintain strong customer relationships to generate repeat business and explore opportunities for expanding existing accounts.

3. Market Development & Intelligence

* Identify new applications, market segments and business opportunities for oxygen absorbers and desiccants.
* Track competitor activities, market trends and customer requirements.
* Identify potential customers and emerging business opportunities in the food industry.
* Participate in relevant food and packaging exhibitions, industry events and networking forums.

4. Business Growth, Payment Collection & Reporting

* Achieve assigned business development, sales and revenue targets.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and track lead-to-business conversion.
* Ensure timely follow-up on customer orders, dispatches and outstanding payments.
* Coordinate with customers and the Finance team to ensure timely payment collection and minimize overdue outstanding.
* Monitor customer credit limits, payment terms and outstanding balances.
* Prepare periodic reports on customer visits, business opportunities, sales pipeline, new account development, sales performance and payment collection.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 2 to 7 years of experience in Business Development / B2B Sales, preferably in the packaging industry.
* Candidates from flexible packaging, food packaging, active packaging, rigid packaging or allied packaging industries will be preferred.
* Should have existing contacts and relationships with customers in Bakery, FMCG, Snacks, Dry Fruits, Sweets & Confectionery, Pet Food, Spices or related food industries.
* Experience in handling institutional / industrial B2B customers and developing new accounts.
* Strong networking, negotiation, communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently generate leads, develop customer relationships and close business.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development activities.

  

**What We Are Looking For:** Someone who is well-connected in the food or packaging industry, understands B2B customer requirements and has the drive to develop new business rather than merely manage existing accounts.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and organized **B2B Inside Sales & Proposal Specialist** to support our business growth initiatives in New York.

This role combines proposal coordination with lead generation, prospect research, and sales follow-up. You will work closely with the Marketing & Sales Managers and collaborate with our technical, operations, and leadership teams to identify business opportunities, coordinate proposal submissions, and maintain consistent communication with prospective and existing clients.

The ideal candidate has strong written and verbal communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a remote work environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. RFP, RFI, & RFQ Research and Coordination**

* Identify and monitor relevant Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), tenders, and other business opportunities.
* Research government procurement portals, public-sector opportunities, corporate procurement platforms, and relevant industry sources.
* Review solicitation documents to identify eligibility criteria, submission requirements, deadlines, and mandatory documentation.
* Maintain a centralized tracker of opportunities, deadlines, submission status, and follow-up actions.
* Coordinate with technical, operations, finance, and leadership teams to collect the information required for submissions.
* Draft, format, proofread, and compile proposal responses and supporting documents.
* Ensure submissions are complete, accurate, professionally presented, and delivered before deadlines.
* Maintain an organized repository of previous proposals, company profiles, case studies, certifications, and standard response documents.
* Track submission outcomes and help identify opportunities to improve the quality and efficiency of future proposals.

  

**2. Lead Generation & Prospect Research**

* Research potential clients, target industries, government agencies, and organizations that may require IT products, managed services, and/or cybersecurity solutions.
* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using online research, company websites, professional networks, procurement portals, and other relevant sources.
* Identify relevant decision-makers and business contacts within target organizations.
* Support outbound lead generation activities through personalized email outreach, LinkedIn research, and other approved channels.
* Identify potential opportunities for cross-selling, repeat business, and engagement with existing clients.

  

**3. Lead Follow-Up & Sales Support**

* Follow up with prospective clients after initial outreach, meetings, referrals, proposals, and other sales interactions.
* Track leads, outstanding responses, upcoming follow-ups, and sales opportunities to ensure timely action.
* Support the Marketing & Sales Manager in maintaining an organized sales pipeline.
* Help re-engage existing clients and previous contacts through relevant, professional communications.
* Prepare basic sales reports covering lead activity, follow-ups, proposal submissions, and opportunity status.

  

**4. Marketing & Business Development Support**

* Assist with market, competitor, and industry research to identify growth opportunities.
* Support the execution of targeted B2B marketing and lead generation campaigns.
* Assist with company presentations, capability statements, service descriptions, and other sales collateral.
* Support social media and content-related activities when required.
* Maintain accurate records of campaign responses, lead sources, and business development activities.
* Provide administrative and coordination support for other marketing and business development initiatives as needed.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 25 years of relevant experience in proposal coordination, business development support, sales operations, or B2B lead generation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience researching business opportunities and coordinating documentation against defined requirements.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Ability to write professional business emails and follow up confidently with prospects.
* Strong ownership, reliability, time management, and follow-through in a remote working environment.
* Willingness to work hours that provide sufficient overlap with U.S. business teams.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with an IT Managed Service Provider (MSP), cybersecurity company, IT consulting firm, or technology services provider.
* Experience with government or public-sector RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and procurement portals.
* Familiarity with North American B2B sales processes and business communication practices.
* Experience using platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Microsoft Planner, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of managed IT services, cloud services, and cybersecurity solutions.
* Experience supporting proposal libraries, reusable content, compliance checklists, and submission workflows.

  

**Who Will Thrive in This Role?**

You are someone who takes ownership of tasks and sees them through to completion. You enjoy research, organizing information, writing professional communications, and coordinating with different teams. You are comfortable balancing detailed documentation with proactive business development activities and understand that consistent follow-up is essential to building business relationships.

If you are organized, resourceful, and eager to contribute to the growth of a technology and cybersecurity services business, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Accountant & Executive - Tally
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a growing distributor of knee and hip implants, orthopedic instruments, and medical devices, supplying hospitals across Hyderabad, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh. As we expand and bring the latest medical technologies to our community, we are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Accountant & Executive to manage our accounts and office administration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain day-to-day accounting entries and books of accounts in **Tally** (sales, purchases, payments, receipts, journal entries, bank reconciliation).
* Maintain and organize all **tax-related documents and records** GST filings support, purchase/sales registers, and statutory records.
* Handle **TDS payments and filing support** calculate, deduct, and deposit TDS on time, and maintain TDS records.
* Assist in preparation of **balance sheets, profit & loss statements**, and monthly/quarterly financial summaries.
* Manage **Excel-based reports** sales data, stock/inventory records, outstanding payments, and expense tracking.
* Coordinate with the CA/auditor for audits, GST returns, and year-end closing.
* Handle general executive duties: invoicing, payment follow-ups with hospitals, vendor coordination, and office documentation.

**Required Skills**

* Working knowledge of **Tally (ERP 9 / Tally Prime)** essential.
* Good command of **Microsoft Excel** (data entry, reports, basic formulas).
* Understanding of basic accounting, **GST, TDS**, and tax documentation.
* Any graduate with Tally certification or practical experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in accounting/bookkeeping (experience in trading/distribution or medical/pharma companies is a plus).

**What We Are Looking For**

* A **skilled, honest, and responsible** person who takes ownership of accounts and records.
* Someone **willing to learn and grow** with the company — we are expanding, and this role can grow into a senior accounts & operations position.
* Good communication in Telugu, Hindi, and basic English.

**Why Join Us**

* Stable, growing business in the healthcare/medical devices sector.
* Opportunity to learn end-to-end accounts and business operations.
* Supportive work environment with long-term growth prospects.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Transformation Risk and Assurance
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities

* **Own the risk view for an assigned workstream.** Proactively assess the assigned process or risk domain across deployment waves using the common Risk & Compliance methodology. Apply sound judgment to new scope, process variants, handoffs and emerging risks, and update mitigations as design and implementation progress.
* **Build strong partnerships with assigned functions.** Engage functional leads across Plan, Make, Source, Deliver, Finance, Customer Excellence or Master Data as relevant, including Global Process Owners, Technical Process Owners and business process owners. Understand how their decisions affect controls and end-to-end outcomes.
* **Connect business risks to financial outcomes.** Examine how transactions are initiated, approved, recorded, reconciled and reported. Prioritize risks to completeness, accuracy, valuation, authorization and timely reporting, alongside material operational risks within the assigned processes.
* **Design and document the future control environment.** Partner with process owners and Finance to define preventive and detective controls, including automated and manual steps, exception management, control ownership, frequency, evidence and escalation. Challenge gaps and avoid controls that cannot operate sustainably after go-live.
* **Address transition and coexistence risks.** Assess handoffs and reconciliations between legacy and S/4HANA environments, temporary workarounds, changing responsibilities and controls during phased deployment; define mitigation and monitoring until the target process is stable.
* **Translate risks into testing and deployment evidence.** Specify risk-based business scenarios, negative cases, end-to-end outcomes and acceptance criteria. Work with testing, data migration, cutover and dress rehearsal teams to ensure relevant risks are tested, exceptions are resolved or mitigated, and evidence is retained.
* **Track issues and residual risks to closure.** Maintain a clear record of assessments, control decisions, test outcomes, open gaps, owners and agreed actions across releases within the assigned workstream. Explain implications for deployment milestones and escalate material issues in time for informed decisions.
* **Support audit readiness and pre-implementation reviews.** Organize the risk and control narrative, design decisions, test evidence and issue status for the assigned workstream. Engage with internal and external auditors during pre-implementation audits, respond to inquiries with the relevant process and program teams, address findings and track remediation through closure.
* **Connect risks across processes, programs and technology.** Identify upstream and downstream effects, dependencies on other transformation programs, and risks at process or system handoffs. Partner with Digital Solution Risk & Assurance on configuration, applications, interfaces, automation and data flows; align with IT compliance and access specialists as needed.
* **Build the integrated release risk profile.** Share risks, evidence gaps and dependencies with other Risk & Compliance Managers and the Senior Manager. Combine findings across workstreams to explain the end-to-end release risk story and inform appropriate de-risking actions and leadership decisions.

**Support control adoption after deployment.** Confirm that process and control owners understand their responsibilities, that procedures and evidence expectations are usable, and that early-live issues feed back into control improvements and subsequent releases.

**Qualifications and experience**

  

* Experience in business process risk, internal controls, Finance transformation or deployment assurance on a complex ERP program, preferably SAP S/4HANA. Direct involvement in at least one implementation or major release is important.
* Ability to map an end-to-end process, identify meaningful failure points and turn them into workable control requirements, test scenarios and evidence expectations.
* Sound understanding of financial risk and controls in supply chain processes, including transaction flows, reconciliations, master data and period-end implications.
* Experience preparing risk and control documentation and evidence for internal or external audit reviews, including pre-implementation audits; familiarity with SOX requirements is advantageous.
* Ability to build effective working relationships with Global Process Owners, Technical Process Owners, functional leads and delivery teams, and to challenge decisions constructively in a matrix organization.
* Ability to connect risks within an assigned stream to upstream and downstream processes, parallel programs and digital solution changes, and contribute clearly to an integrated release risk profile.
* Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment in prioritizing risks, and willingness to investigate process detail while presenting concise conclusions to senior stakeholders.
* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field. Experience in a regulated life-sciences environment is advantageous.

* Intelligent in approach: analytical, creative, and thoughtful.
* Dynamic in execution: adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

**Who you are**

* High agency. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, own it and close it.

* Ambitious and hungry to prove yourself; you want more ownership, fast.
* Ready to get your hands dirty: test the build, fix the data, sit with ops.
* Happy to work hard, especially around go-lives.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead  Ultima Platform
jobs.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Lead Ultima Platform

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)

Department: Engineering – Platform / Infrastructure

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior (10–15+ years)

Role Summary

Diamanti is seeking a Senior Technical Lead to lead the design, development, and

evolution of the Ultima platform, a Kubernetes-native hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)

appliance.

This role requires deep expertise across Kubernetes internals, CSI and CNI subsystems,

storage architecture, embedded and kernel-level development, and high-performance

networking (including SR-IOV). You will act as a hands-on technical authority, owning

critical platform subsystems end-to-end while also serving as a senior escalation point

for complex customer issues.

Key Responsibilities

Ultima Platform & Storage Architecture Ownership

* Own the end-to-end storage architecture for the Ultima platform, supporting

enterprise-grade, stateful Kubernetes workloads.

* Design and evolve storage solutions across:
* NVMe-based block storage
* Distributed storage concepts
* Performance tiers and failure domains
* Make architectural decisions balancing performance, scalability, durability, and

operational simplicity.

* Define and maintain storage best practices and reference architectures for

internal teams and customers.

CSI-Based Storage Subsystems

* Architect, implement, and optimize Diamanti CSI drivers, including:
* Volume provisioning and lifecycle management
* Snapshots, cloning, resizing, and performance classes
* Failure handling, idempotency, and upgrade safety
* Ensure CSI subsystems integrate correctly with:
* Kubernetes scheduling and lifecycle events
* Kernel block layer and underlying storage hardware
* Drive root cause analysis for complex CSI and storage-related issues.

CNI, Networking & Acceleration

* Own CNI-based networking subsystems, including:
* Pod networking models and isolation
* Network policy enforcement
* Performance-critical data paths
* Lead design and optimization of high-performance networking, including:
* SR-IOV and NIC offloading
* Low-latency, high-throughput data paths
* Ensure tight integration between CNI, kernel networking, and hardware

acceleration.

Embedded & Kernel-Level Development

* Design and develop embedded Linux services, kernel modules, and low-level

platform components.

* Lead kernel-level debugging and optimization across:
* Storage I/O paths
* Networking stacks
* Interrupt handling, memory management, and performance tuning
* Ensure kernel and embedded components meet enterprise reliability and stability

requirements.

Performance, Reliability & Failure Handling

* Own platform performance benchmarking and regression analysis for storage

and networking.

* Define performance baselines (latency, IOPS, throughput) and track them across

releases.

* Design and validate behavior under:
* Disk, node, and network failures
* Power loss and restart scenarios
* Rolling upgrades and scale operations
* Ensure data durability, recoverability, and predictable failure behavior.

Customer Escalations & Technical Leadership

* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex customer issues related to:
* Storage, CSI, and CNI subsystems
* Kernel-level and performance-critical problems
* Lead deep-dive investigations into customer-reported issues, working across

Engineering, QA, and Support.

* Provide clear technical guidance and direction to engineering teams during

escalations.

* Ensure customer issues are driven to root cause, resolution, and long-term fix,

not just workarounds.

* Translate customer learnings into product and platform improvements.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

* Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across:
* Storage and networking
* CSI/CNI subsystems
* Kernel and embedded development
* Review designs, code, and test plans to ensure high quality, performance, and

maintainability.

* Raise the bar for systems engineering excellence across the team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner closely with:
* Product Management to translate customer requirements into technical

solutions

* QA to ensure comprehensive validation of platform subsystems
* Support and Services teams for smooth customer deployments and

escalations

* Act as a technical bridge between internal teams and customer-facing functions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10–15+ years of experience in systems, platform, embedded, or infrastructure

engineering.

Mandatory Requirements

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) – required
* Deep hands-on expertise in:
* Kubernetes architecture and internals
* CSI and CNI frameworks and implementations
* Linux kernel internals and kernel-level development
* Embedded Linux systems

Storage & Networking Expertise

* Strong experience with:
* NVMe and block storage architectures
* Distributed storage concepts
* CSI driver development and lifecycle management
* CNI plugin development and pod networking
* SR-IOV, NIC offloads, and high-performance networking

Preferred / Differentiating Skills

* Experience with Kubernetes-native HCI platforms or appliance-based

infrastructure products.

* Strong programming skills in C, C++, Go, and Python.
* Experience compiling and customizing Linux kernels.
* Familiarity with hardware bring-up, PCIe devices, or firmware interactions.
* Experience working in on-prem, air-gapped, or regulated environments.
* Prior experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or Architect.

Key Success Metrics

* Stability, performance, and scalability of storage, CSI, CNI, and kernel subsystems.
* Reduction in customer escalations related to platform, storage, and networking.
* Time-to-resolution and quality of root cause analysis for critical issues.
* Successful delivery of complex platform initiatives.
* Technical growth and effectiveness of the engineering team.

Why Join Diamanti?

* Lead deep systems engineering for a Kubernetes-native HCI appliance.
* Own storage, networking, and kernel subsystems with real enterprise impact.
* Act as a key technical authority for customer-critical issues.
* Influence long-term platform architecture and technical direction.
* Build mission-critical on-prem infrastructure for modern workloads

1. **Purpose of the Position**

Lead the Mechanical and Electronics Design & New Product Development functions from customer requirement and feasibility through design, prototype, testing, validation and successful transfer to mass production. Drive innovative, reliable and cost-effective automotive products for domestic and export customers, ensuring QCD performance and compliance with customer requirements, APQP, PPAP, ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.

2. **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Strategy & customer interface: Define product development priorities and timelines; review RFQs, drawings and specifications; assess technical feasibility, risks, cost and resources; lead customer technical discussions and design reviews.
* Electronics development: Guide circuit, PCB and hardware design, component selection and product integration for automotive electronics such as sensors, actuators, switches, controllers and EV applications; review schematics, PCB layouts and BOM.
* Mechanical development: Lead mechanical design of housings, enclosures, brackets, plastic/metal components and assemblies; review 2D/3D designs, materials, dimensions and GD&T ensure DFM/DFA and manufacturability.
* Integrated product engineering: Ensure effective mechanical-electronics integration, fitment and functionality; coordinate with tooling, moulding, machining and component suppliers; resolve design and manufacturing issues.
* Design validation & launch: Lead prototype builds, trials, verification and validation; coordinate applicable electrical, mechanical, environmental, thermal, vibration and durability testing; secure customer approval and ensure smooth production handover.
* APQP & engineering control: Ensure design reviews, design records, DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow, PPAP and customer-specific requirements are addressed; control drawings, BOM, revisions and ECN/PCN.
* Project, cost & supplier management: Manage multiple projects, milestones and budgets; coordinate with Sales, Purchase, SCM, Quality, Production and PPC; drive VA/VE, localization, alternate components and cost optimization.
* Team leadership & problem solving: Lead, allocate and review work of 2 Mechanical and 2 Electronics Engineers; develop team competency; lead RCA, 8D and corrective actions; report project status, risks and performance to management.

3. **Authorities**

Review and approve designs, drawings, BOM, technical specifications and development plans within the approval matrix; allocate team resources; coordinate customer and supplier technical matters; recommend prototypes, testing, tooling, software, equipment and CAPEX; initiate engineering changes and escalate critical risks.

4. **Qualification**, Experience & Competencies

B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering; minimum 15 years of relevant automotive product design and development experience. Proven ability to lead both Mechanical and Electronics engineering teams and manage products from concept to mass production. Strong understanding of electronic circuit/PCB design, sensors, actuators, embedded systems, mechanical design, 2D/3D modelling, GD&T, tooling, DFM/DFA, product testing, APQP, PPAP, DFMEA/PFMEA and IATF 16949. Strong leadership, customer-handling, project management and problem-solving skills. Mechanical CAD and electronics design software knowledge preferred.

5. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

On-time project completion; customer design and PPAP approvals; successful product validation and mass-production handover; design quality and reduction in design-related failures; development cost and VA/VE savings; timely closure of customer/audit issues; effective team performance and competency development.

6. **Key Interfaces & General Responsibilities**

Internal: Sales, Purchase/SCM, Production, Quality, PPC and Management. External: Domestic/export customers, component suppliers, tooling vendors and testing laboratories. Maintain confidentiality of customer/company designs and records; follow company procedures, quality, safety and statutory requirements; perform other relevant duties assigned by management.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

Project Planning:

* Define the scope of the project and sign off with the user team.
* Prepare cost estimation for the project.
* Prepare the necessary documentation, capital proposals and get the project approval for execution.
* Create a detailed work plan which identifies and sequences the activities needed to successfully complete the project
* Ensure that User Requirement Specification for equipment and other critical items are available and approved.
* Determine the resources (time, money, equipment, etc.) required to complete the project
* Develop a schedule for project completion that effectively allocates the resources to the activities
* Review the project schedule with senior management and all other staff that will be affected by the project activities; revise the schedule as required
* Determine the objectives and measures upon which the project will be evaluated at its completion.

Project Team:

* Define the roles of Project team members based on the skill to deliver the projects with RFT.
* Hire the required contractor resources and co-ordinate within team to deliver the project on time.
* Adequate resources are available to execute the project.
* Hiring of external resources on need base.

Project execution:

* Prepare procurement plan and release Purchase orders in co-ordination with Procurement team to ensure timely delivery of the project.
* Necessary detailing work is completed and approved before executing the project.
* Necessary construction drawings are available for construction.
* Involve third party consultant if required for equipment, piping and support design.
* FAT and other inspections are completed as per project QAP
* Execute the project according to the project plan.
* Track the change if any in project scope or specification during project execution with necessary change control documentation and escalating issues where necessary.
* Develop test certificates and records to document project activities.
* Monitor the progress of the project and make adjustments as necessary to ensure the successful completion of the project
* Establish a communication schedule to update stakeholders on the progress of the project
* Review the quality of the work completed with the project team on a regular basis to ensure that it meets the project standards
* Recording and managing project issues and escalating where necessary.

Budget control:

* Monitor the project spend against approved budget on regular basis (monthly/bimonthly) and communicate.

Project Evaluation:

* Project deliverables are on time, within budget and at the required level of quality
* Evaluate the outcomes of the project as established during the planning phase

Project closure:

* Handover all project related documents, equipment drawings and manuals, all approved drawings & inspection reports to Plant Maintenance Manager and design office.
* Co-Ordinate and provide necessary documents for closure of MOC.
* All the bills are settled related to the project.
* Prepare project capitalization documents and handing over to finance for closure.

Critical experience

* At-least 10 years experience in AI Plant/ Chemical/Petrochemical Plant Projects/ Maintenance with min 5 Years Project Management experience
* Hands on experience to work independently in rectifying the equipments problems

* Exploring and developing new vendors

* Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams.

* Age: **25–30 years**.

* Strong awareness of global design trends, emerging technologies, and market insights.

jobs.title: ITSM Manager - Trainer
jobs.description:
**Role: ITSM Manager or Trainer  
Exp: 8-10 Yrs  
Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Kolkata  
  
Summary**

The ITSM Lead (Sr. Manager) is responsible for defining, governing, and continuously

improving IT Service Management processes across a rapidly growing global

organization. This role ensures IT services are delivered consistently, efficiently, and

with a relentless focus on the customer experience.

As the company continues to expand its international footprint, this position becomes

essential in aligning global service delivery to business priorities and maintaining a

unified ITSM strategy. The ITSM Lead will play a central role in overseeing the launch and

ongoing performance of a Global Service Desk spanning India, Poland, and Latin

America, ensuring alignment of processes, standards, and outcomes.

The ITSM Lead will also drive the evolution of ServiceNow, with a specific focus

on optimizing Incident and Request Management workflows, enabling process

automation, and improving transparency and reporting across IT. This position will

report directly to the Global Head of Support & ITSM.

**Responsibilities**

• Service Management Leadership

* Define, mature, and govern ITSM processes across the enterprise—including Incident, Request, Problem, and Knowledge Management—aligned with ITIL best practices and business needs.
* Lead ongoing ServiceNow improvement initiatives, with a strong focus on enhancing Incident and Request Management workflows, automation, and end[1]
* Partner with development teams to design, test, and deploy new ServiceNow capabilities, ensuring scalability and efficiency across global support operations.
* Establish and maintain SLAs, KPIs, and OLAs to drive accountability, transparency, and measurable service quality.
* Ensure all ITSM processes are consistent and adaptable across multiple regions and time zones.

• Global Service Desk Oversight

* Provide leadership and governance over the Global Service Desk operations across India, Poland, and LATAM, ensuring a unified delivery model and consistent customer experience
* Define the operating framework for regional Service Desk pods, ensuring alignment with global ITSM standards and service delivery expectations.
* Monitor global performance metrics, identify trends, and drive initiatives to improve first-contact resolution, response times, and customer satisfaction.
* Partners with regional lead to foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Support the establishment of a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 service continuity and seamless user support globally.

• Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

* Champion process simplification and automation through ServiceNow and other ITSM tools, leveraging analytics to drive continuous improvement.
* Use data-driven insights to identify service trends, eliminate recurring issues, and enhance global operational efficiency.
* Develop and deliver regular executive reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into service health, volume trends, and improvement opportunities.
* Drive ITSM maturity through standardization, governance, and consistent process adoption across all regions.

• Customer Experience & Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as the voice of the customer, ensuring IT services continuously evolve to meet the needs of the business and end users.
* Collaborate closely with business and IT leaders in the U.S. to ensure alignment between technology service delivery and organizational objectives.
* Provide strategic recommendations on ITSM process improvements, tool enhancements, and support models to optimize service performance.
* Partner with other IT functions (Engineering, InfoSec, Facilities, HR) to ensure seamless collaboration and end-to-end service delivery.

• Leadership & People Development

o Lead, mentor, and develop global ITSM and Service Desk teams, promoting a

culture of collaboration, innovation, and service excellence.

o Provide clear direction, training, and guidance to ensure alignment with ITSM

standards and best practices.

o Partner with offshore and regional leaders to build strong local teams

while maintaining centralized governance and process ownership.

Collaborate with peer IT leaders to ensure global consistency in IT operations

and customer support.

**Skills**

* 10+ years of progressive IT operations or ITSM experience, including 5+ years in a
* leadership role within a global or multinational organization.
* Proven experience designing and optimizing ServiceNow Incident and Request
* Management workflows, including automation, reporting, and dashboarding.
* Deep understanding of ITIL best practices and how to apply them in dynamic,
* growth-oriented organizations.
* Experience overseeing or partnering with global Service Desk operations across
* multiple regions or delivery centers.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale process improvement and service
* transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to present data[1]
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven automation is a plus.

**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or
* related field (or equivalent experience).
