jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Job Description:

  7–10 years of experience in product ownership, Finance systems, FP&A, cost management, allocations, or Finance transformation.

        Strong understanding of cost allocations, profitability management, driver-based costing, and financial reporting processes.

        Experience owning product roadmaps and delivering enterprise Finance initiatives.

        Experience preparing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.

        Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test case development, defect management, business validation, and sign-off.

        Strong project and stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines.

        Ability to translate Finance requirements into clear functional specifications and actionable deliverables for technology teams.

        High-level understanding of Oracle PCM, Oracle EPM, or similar profitability management platforms.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership & Roadmap Management

        Own and manage the Allocations and Profitability Management product roadmap and delivery backlog.

        Prioritize business requirements, enhancements, and strategic initiatives based on business value, risk, and delivery capacity.

        Define delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and expected business outcomes.

        Ensure alignment between Finance objectives, allocation methodologies, and technology solutions.

Business & Functional Requirements

        Gather, analyze, and document requirements from Finance, FP&A, Accounting, and other stakeholders.

        Prepare and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), user stories, process flows, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.

        Translate business requirements into clear, actionable deliverables for technology and implementation teams.

        Review solution designs and configuration proposals to confirm alignment with approved requirements and Finance processes.

        Maintain requirements traceability and manage changes to scope, requirements, and design decisions.

Allocations & Profitability Management

        Partner with Finance stakeholders to define and optimize allocation methodologies and profitability processes.

        Support decisions related to cost pools, allocation rules, allocation drivers, calculation logic, and profitability reporting.

        Drive process standardization, controls, transparency, and continuous improvement across allocation and profitability functions.

        Ensure solutions meet Finance governance, reporting, reconciliation, and audit requirements.

        Maintain a high-level understanding of PCM functionality, dimensions, allocation rules, calculation logic, reporting, and upstream/downstream integrations.

        Work with technology teams to support solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, enhancements, and production support.

        Assess business requirements and determine impacts on PCM calculations, allocation processes, integrations, controls, and reporting.

Testing, Business Readiness & Delivery

        Develop and review UAT strategies, test plans, test scenarios, test cases, expected results, and business validation evidence.

        Coordinate System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business and technology teams.

        Track defects, facilitate triage, prioritize fixes, coordinate retesting, and obtain business sign-off before deployment.

        Manage project timelines, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issue resolution to keep initiatives on schedule.

        Coordinate training, communications, change management, production readiness, and post-deployment support.

Stakeholder Management & Continuous Improvement

        Facilitate requirements workshops, prioritization sessions, design reviews, status meetings, and leadership updates.

        Monitor metrics related to allocation accuracy, operational efficiency, profitability reporting, and business value.

        Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and process simplification across Finance.

Education & QualificationsRequired

        Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

        7–10 years of experience in Finance systems, product management, FP&A, cost management, allocations, or Finance transformation.

        Strong understanding of allocation methodologies and profitability management concepts.

        Demonstrated experience documenting Business Requirement and Functional Design documents, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.

        Experience leading or coordinating UAT planning, test case development, defect tracking, business validation, and sign-off.

        Experience managing cross-functional projects, product roadmaps, delivery schedules, and stakeholder relationships.

        Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, documentation, and organizational skills.

Preferred

        Experience with Oracle Profitability and Cost Management (PCM).

        Experience with Oracle EPM, EPBCS/PBCS, FCCS, or similar Finance platforms.

        Knowledge of activity-based costing, driver-based costing, and profitability analysis.

        Experience supporting Finance transformation programs in large enterprise environments.

        Familiarity with Agile delivery methods, backlog management, and release planning.

Core Skills

        Product ownership and roadmap management

        Finance allocations, cost management, and profitability management

        Business requirements and functional design documentation (BRD/FDD)

        UAT planning, test case development, and defect management

        Cross-functional project and stakeholder management

        Finance systems experience

jobs.title: Manager, Digital & AI Solutions
jobs.description:
**About Ghintell**  
Ghintell is the AI-first healthcare intelligence, research and analytics company within Zealth Group. Together with Zealth, our market access business, and ijovi, our strategy and creative business, we support some of the worlds largest pharmaceutical companies. Our Bengaluru centre of excellence brings together expertise in medical research, analytics and health economics.  
We are expanding how we deliver that expertise through web applications, interactive dashboards and connected data solutions that help clients access insights and put them to work.

**The opportunity**  
We are looking for an internationally experienced, business-minded leader to head our Digital & AI Solutions team in Bengaluru and help our pharmaceutical clients get more value from data, analytics and AI.  
You will be the bridge between our clients, our consultants and our technical team. You will understand what clients need, shape the right solution with the team and explain technical choices in understandable language, so that clients and colleagues can make good decisions with confidence.  
You will lead a team spanning analytics, IT and web application engineering. This is not a hands-on development role, but it calls for enough technical understanding to set direction, ask the right questions and ensure that everything we deliver is secure, reliable and well run.  
The role is international by nature. You will work across cultures and time zones, with colleagues in Copenhagen and the US and with clients across North America, Europe and international markets.  
You will report to the VP of Finance, IT and AI Analytics, with a dotted line to the Site Head in Bengaluru.

**What you will do**  
**Lead and develop the team.** Set priorities, coach team members and build a culture of quality, ownership and continuous improvement.  
**Understand client needs.** Work with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business questions and turn them into clear, practical solutions.  
**Translate between business and technology.** Explain technical options, risks and trade-offs in simple terms, and make sure the team understands the business context.  
**Own delivery.** Make sure solutions are delivered on time, to the agreed quality and within budget, from scoping to handover and ongoing support.  
 **Keep solutions secure and well run.** Make sure the team follows good practice for security, data protection and client IT requirements, and lead our input into client IT and security reviews.  
**Grow what we offer.** Shape new services in data, analytics and AI with colleagues across Zealth Group, and contribute to proposals and client conversations.  
**Oversee internal IT.** Work with our Senior IT Partner to keep internal systems reliable and aligned with business priorities.

**How you will work with AI**  
AI is changing how we deliver. Our consultants and analysts create prototypes, dashboards and tools with AI. You will help the team turn the best of these into solutions clients can rely on, decide where AI adds real value for clients, and make sure it is used responsibly, with the right tools and data for each engagement.  
Deep AI engineering expertise is not required. We value curiosity, sound judgement and the ability to explain clearly what AI can and cannot do.

**What you bring**

* At least six years of experience in consulting, professional services, analytics or digital delivery, including experience leading teams.
* Substantial experience in international companies or with clients across several countries, working comfortably across cultures and time zones.
* A track record of working directly with clients and senior stakeholders and building trusted relationships.  
   Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical work to client value.
* Sufficient technical understanding of data, analytics, web applications and cloud services to guide a technical team and make sound decisions.
* The ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and simply.  
   Excellent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life science or healthcare, a consulting or professional services background, and experience with AI-enabled services or digital products would be valuable.

**What we offer**

* A leadership role with an established team and a direct say in how the function grows.
* Meaningful ownership of solutions used by leading pharmaceutical companies.
* Close collaboration with colleagues across Bengaluru, Copenhagen and the US.
* An environment where you can apply new technology to practical client needs and see the impact of your work.
* A culture grounded in trust, direct communication, teamwork and accountability, drawing on our Scandinavian roots and international outlook.  
  **How to apply**  
  Send your CV and a short cover letter describing a client solution you were responsible for, how you led the team behind it, and how you explained it to non-technical stakeholders. Please share only examples you are authorised to disclose.  
  We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Voice and Digital Sales
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

The Digital Sales professional will own the sales pipeline generated through digital channels, end to end. Beyond closing deals, the role turns every customer interaction and funnel stage into intelligence that improves marketing messaging, targeting, and funnel design. The person acts as the bridge between Sales, Marketing, and Product, using 360-degree funnel feedback to find and fix leaks from the first ad impression to activation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Digital Sales Ownership

* Own revenue and conversion targets for leads sourced from digital channels (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, website, referral, and other digital sources).
* Manage the inbound enquiry-to-activation cycle: lead qualification, follow-up cadence, plan recommendation, objection handling, and closure.
* Set and enforce SLAs for lead response time, follow-up, and activation, and track adherence.
* Work with the Field and Sales organisation so digital leads are routed, tracked, and closed consistently.

2. 360-Degree Funnel Feedback

* Build and maintain a view of the full funnel: awareness enquiry qualification plan selection payment installation activation retention and referral.
* Track conversion, drop-off, and time-in-stage at every step, split by lead source, city, plan, and persona.
* Identify where prospects stall, abandon, or go cold, and diagnose the cause (price, speed of response, plan fit, availability, form friction, trust, or competitor offer).
* Produce a fortnightly funnel health report with clear actions, owners, and expected impact.

3. Customer Interaction Insights

* Capture structured call and chat insights: objections, questions, competitor mentions, and reasons for drop-off or purchase.
* Convert recurring objections and questions into a prioritised list for marketing (messaging gaps) and product (feature or process gaps).
* Listen to call recordings and chat transcripts regularly to validate what the data shows.

4. Marketing Loophole Detection

* Audit end-to-end marketing journeys, from ad copy and landing page to enquiry form, thank-you page, and sales follow-up, to find breaks in the chain.
* Flag mismatches between what ads promise and what the sales conversation delivers (for example, speed, price, coverage, or installation timelines).
* Identify attribution and lead-quality gaps, such as junk referrals, duplicate enquiries, or leads from channels that never convert.

5. Funnel and Messaging Recommendations

* Recommend changes to messaging at each stage: ad copy, landing page, plan descriptions, sales script, and follow-up communication.
* Recommend targeting changes based on which audiences, geographies, and personas convert and retain best.
* Propose funnel changes such as form simplification, call-back triggers, instant-activation flows, or offer structures, and back each with a hypothesis.
* Run A/B tests or structured pilots on recommendations and report results.

6. Cross-Functional Execution

* Partner with Digital Marketing (Performance, SEO, CRO) on campaign and landing page changes.
* Partner with Product on SmartWiFi, the super app, and onboarding flows based on customer feedback.
* Partner with Field and Sales leadership on lead handover, territory coverage, and objection-handling training.
* Present funnel findings and recommendations to senior leadership, with a clear impact estimate for each.

Impact Expectations

For each recommendation, the role is expected to state the expected action, the outcome it should drive, and the business impact (for example, higher lead-to-activation rate, lower cost per activation, or faster response time). Results are reviewed monthly against that forecast.

AI is more than a third area of its own. AI-enabled workflows, agents and engineering harnesses are also built into Development and Lifecycle. You drive delivery across all three areas and make sure they work as one organisation, not as silos.

Your Future Tasks

* Lead GCC RDE India as a delivery organisation. You lead the three area leads (Development, Lifecycle, AI) and, through them, their teams.
* Own the budget. You own the budget of all three areas, and that includes AI usage. You control cost against this budget and release in writing any spending beyond an area's approved budget. This includes AI consumption (tokens), also for work packages Weiherhammer commissions in India, as well as building harnesses and agents, trial work, cloud hosting during trials and AI governance effort.
* Make AI consumption measurable. You set up how AI consumption is measured for each work package of Weiherhammer commissions, with KPIs that compare the tokens used with the output they produce, and the reasoning behind each number. You discuss this mechanism with the ordering sites, get it approved, and then report against it.
* Deliver against commitments. You turn the requirements and work packages from the ordering sites into delivery plans that Pune can execute: who works on what, milestones, quality criteria, acceptance and escalation. You agree quality criteria with the ordering sites, make sure results are checked before they are handed over, and follow up on defects.
* Report. You deliver a monthly report per area on bookings, consumption, forecast and milestones to the programme coordination in Germany.
* Orchestrate the three area leads: capacities, priorities, dependencies, interfaces and escalation paths.
* Keep one shared technical foundation. Weiherhammer and BHS Intralogistics both order from GCC RDE India. You orchestrate their orders so that the areas build on one shared foundation and no parallel world grows up beside it.

  

* Be the single point of contact between GCC RDE India, the ordering sites, the Head GCC and top management, and translate technical progress into clear business updates. For our global engineering and AI transformation programme, you present delivery status, business value, budget and forecast, risks, resource needs and decision requests credibly to senior and top management.
* Build the leadership team. You lead senior hiring together with the Head GCC and HR, and you onboard, develop and retain the area leads.
* Connect Pune and Germany. You lead Pune delegations to Weiherhammer and host German delegations in Pune, in the rhythm the current topics need, with the leads and experts those topics need.
* Grow the organisation on delivery. Growth follows demonstrated delivery and is re-assessed at each step.

  

What This Role Is Not

  

This is a leadership and delivery role, not a specialist role. Technical direction runs from the technical architects in Germany directly to the area leads, and the area leads own their technology. You need enough technical understanding to follow and challenge them, but you do not decide technical questions.

You must understand AI-enabled engineering delivery well enough to challenge feasibility, capacity demand, delivery risk and business value, and to turn technical direction into delivery that works across functions.

  

Requirements

  

Must have:

* Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable qualification.
* 15+ years of professional experience, of which 5+ years leading managers.
* Has run a GCC, a captive centre or the delivery organisation of an offshore engineering or development centre for a European or German parent.
* Proven experience managing complex cross-functional engineering or digital-transformation work packages across onshore and offshore teams, with measurable responsibility for delivery, cost, quality and schedule.
* Budget and cost responsibility across several teams, with controlling discipline.
* Has managed managers, not only individual contributors, and has grown an organisation of several teams step by step, tied to delivery.
* Board-level stakeholder management across sites and cultures, in English.
* Hiring and onboarding of senior people in the Pune talent market.

  

* General technical background in engineering, manufacturing or industrial equipment, enough to understand a technical strategy built on engineering data, cloud and AI, and to follow what the three area leads talk about.
* Experience establishing scalable, reusable workflows or platforms across several engineering processes and tools, rather than managing individual software licences or isolated AI use cases. Relevant examples include SAP, Solid Edge, MATLAB, other engineering software and lifecycle workflows.
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and decision-making, with a structured and delivery-oriented approach.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership skills across diverse teams and geographies.
* Very good written and spoken English; willingness to travel to Germany regularly.

  

Good to have:

* German language skills, or experience working with a German headquarters.
* Experience in industrial machinery, capital equipment, manufacturing or R&D environments.

  

Explicitly not required:

  

* Specialist depth in mechanical, electrical, data or AI engineering.

  

We Offer You

  

* The chance to build and lead a new delivery organization inside a growing Global Capability Centre.
* Close work with international leadership and technical teams in Germany and India.
* Ownership and responsibility from the first day, in a solidly financed organization.
* Influence on organizational capabilities, processes and long-term growth.
* Flexibility, openness and an entrepreneurial working culture.

  
  

Regards,

Rivka Pawar

jobs.title: Head GRID Automation & Digital System
jobs.description:
ARAKAN SMART GRID   
   
WE ARE HIRING  
   
HEAD GRID AUTOMATION & DIGITAL SYSTEMS  
   
Smart Grid | Distribution Automation | SCADA | FPI | GIS | GridWatch  
   
Location: Pune, Maharashtra\  
Experience: 10 to15 Years\  
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / E&TC Engineering\  
Preferred Qualification: M.Tech in Power Systems, Control Systems or Automation\  
Salary: 80,000 to 1,30,000 per month\  
Employment Type: Full-time\  
Reporting To: Managing Director / Business Head Grid Solutions  
   
   
 1. ABOUT ARAKAN SMART GRID SOLUTIONS  
   
Arakan Grid Solutions, a specialised division of Arakan GROUP., is being established to deliver advanced Smart Grid Technologies, Electrical Distribution Automation, Communicable Fault Passage Indicators (FPI), SCADA Integration and Digital Grid Monitoring solutions.  
   
Our objective is to provide end-to-end technology and EPC solutions to electricity distribution companies, utilities, infrastructure developers and power-sector organisations.  
   
Our business activities include:  
   
- Communicable FPI supply, installation and commissioning.  
- 11 kV , 22 kv and 33 kvfeeder monitoring and fault detection systems.  
- RTU/FRTU and communication gateway integration.  
- SCADA-based feeder monitoring.  
- GIS-based electrical distribution network mapping.  
- Digital grid monitoring and analytics.  
- Turnkey distribution automation EPC projects.  
- Annual maintenance and technical support services.  
   
We are developing our own branded digital monitoring platform, ARAKAN GRIDWATCH, through a technology partnership with an established SCADA software provider.  
   
We are looking for an experienced technical leader who can establish, manage and scale this technology business.  
 2. ROLE OVERVIEW  
   
The Head Grid Automation & Digital Systems will be responsible for the complete technical direction and implementation of Arakan Grid Solutions.  
   
The selected candidate will lead the engineering team, manage SCADA technology partnerships, supervise FPI and RTU integration, and oversee the development of Arakan GridWatch.  
   
The candidate will act as the principal technical authority for the organisation and ensure successful delivery of turnkey distribution automation projects.  
   
The SCADA core engine will be sourced from an established technology partner. The candidate will be responsible for technical integration, configuration and supervision of Arakan's customised GridWatch modules rather than developing an entire SCADA engine from scratch.  
 3. ALTERNATIVE DESIGNATIONS FOR CANDIDATE SEARCH  
   
Candidates currently working under any of the following designations may be considered:  
   
1. General Manager Smart Grid & Automation  
2. General Manager SCADA & Distribution Automation  
3. Senior Manager SCADA & Automation  
4. DGM Smart Grid Projects  
5. DGM Distribution Automation  
6. AGM SCADA & Power Systems  
7. Head Substation Automation  
8. Head Digital Grid Solutions  
9. Technical Head Power Automation  
10. Principal Engineer Power Systems Automation  
11. SCADA / ADMS Solution Architect  
12. Lead Engineer Distribution Automation  
13. Project Director SCADA & Smart Grid  
14. Senior Manager Utility Automation  
15. Technical Manager RTU, FRTU & SCADA  
   
Candidates from DISCOMs, transmission utilities, SCADA system integrators, smart grid companies and electrical automation EPC organisations are encouraged to apply.  
   
 4. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
   
 A. Smart Grid & Distribution Automation  
   
- Lead technical planning and implementation of smart grid and distribution automation projects.  
- Develop technical solutions for 11 kV distribution feeder monitoring.  
- Design system architecture for communicable FPI-based fault detection and monitoring.  
- Evaluate and select suitable FPI, RTU, FRTU and communication gateway equipment.  
- Prepare technical specifications, system architecture documents and engineering standards.  
- Study utility tender specifications and develop suitable technical solutions.  
- Ensure compatibility between equipment supplied by different OEMs.  
- Develop standardised solutions for utility deployments.  
   
 B. SCADA System Architecture & Integration  
   
- Lead SCADA architecture design and implementation.  
- Evaluate and manage established SCADA technology partners.  
- Supervise SCADA platform configuration and integration.  
- Define data acquisition architecture between FPI, RTU/FRTU, gateways and SCADA servers.  
- Oversee integration using IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus RTU/TCP and MQTT.  
- Establish communication architecture using 4G, Ethernet and other approved communication technologies.  
- Configure and review device tags, alarms, events and historical records.  
- Ensure reliable communication between field devices and monitoring systems.  
- Supervise cloud-based and customer-hosted SCADA deployments.  
- Coordinate troubleshooting and technical escalations.  
   
 C. FPI, RTU & Field Device Integration  
   
- Evaluate communicable FPI products from different OEMs.  
- Review FPI specifications, sensing technologies and communication capabilities.  
- Supervise integration of overhead and underground FPI devices where applicable.  
- Define RTU/FRTU configuration and communication requirements.  
- Develop device signal lists and communication mapping documents.  
- Verify fault indication, restoration indication, device health and communication status.  
- Coordinate factory testing and field integration.  
- Develop standard installation and commissioning procedures.  
- Ensure interoperability between different OEM devices and GridWatch.  
   
 D. Arakan GridWatch Product Development  
   
- Lead the technical roadmap and architecture of Arakan GridWatch.  
- Coordinate development with the SCADA technology partner and software team.  
- Define requirements for customer dashboards and web-based monitoring.  
- Supervise integration of SCADA data through APIs and databases.  
- Develop requirements for customer-wise and utility-wise dashboards.  
- Ensure scalable architecture for multiple customers and large device networks.  
- Review software development progress, testing and release management.  
- Maintain product specifications and technical documentation.  
- Ensure appropriate ownership and control of Arakan-funded custom product modules.  
   
Proposed GridWatch modules:  
   
1. Live FPI monitoring and device status.  
2. Feeder and substation GIS mapping.  
3. Fault and restoration alerts.  
4. Historical event monitoring.  
5. Feeder-wise fault analytics.  
6. Communication health monitoring.  
7. Maintenance and field-team workflow.  
8. Customer dashboards and reports.  
9. Device management and configuration records.  
10. Multi-customer user access and reporting.  
   
E. GIS & Digital Grid Intelligence  
   
- Supervise GIS-based mapping of electrical distribution networks.  
- Define mapping standards for substations, feeders, poles, DTCs and FPI locations.  
- Oversee GPS-based field asset mapping.  
- Coordinate GIS database architecture and data management.  
- Integrate GIS information with SCADA and GridWatch.  
- Develop requirements for fault-event visualisation on feeder maps.  
- Supervise feeder analytics and network performance reports.  
- Ensure accuracy and consistency of utility asset information.  
   
 F. Technology Partner & OEM Management  
   
- Identify and evaluate SCADA software technology partners.  
- Lead technical evaluation of FPI and RTU manufacturers.  
- Review technical capabilities, integration flexibility and product compliance.  
- Coordinate technical discussions and product demonstrations.  
- Review API/SDK availability and integration documentation.  
- Ensure appropriate white-label, deployment and customisation rights.  
- Manage technical support and escalation mechanisms.  
- Coordinate training and knowle

- Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
- Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
- Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
- High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

1. Direct hands-on experience with Seismic Pages, LiveDocs, digital sales rooms, email experiences, microapps, or similar capabilities.

1. Demonstrated interest in and ability to leverage AI-enabled tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar technologies, to work more efficiently, streamline routine tasks, and improve productivity.

1. Experience working within an offshore/onshore operating model and coordinating work across time zones.
2. Demonstrated interest in and ability to leverage AI-enabled tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar technologies, to work more efficiently, streamline routine tasks, and improve productivity.
3. Familiarity with Salesforce-connected Seismic experiences, campaign lists, embedded applications, data integrations, or related sales and marketing workflows.
4. Experience working in financial services or another regulated environment.
5. Knowledge of content governance, lifecycle management, taxonomy, metadata, tagging, and content findability.
6. Experience executing testing for platform releases, enhancements, workflow changes, integrations, or automation.
7. Experience supporting user onboarding, training, platform adoption, or field enablement activities.
8. Familiarity with marketing campaigns, sales communications, content maintenance, or distribution enablement.
9. Experience working with content management systems, digital asset management platforms, marketing technology, or other enterprise platforms.
10. Experience executing standardized processes and supporting process or workflow improvements.

**Responsibilities**

1. Publish new content and maintain existing content in Seismic, including metadata, tagging, content properties, ownership, data sources, review and expiration dates, links, and version accuracy.
2. Execute day-to-day Seismic platform activities, including adding, removing, and updating users; supporting license management; maintaining user lists and profile information; and completing other routine platform administration.
3. Maintain user and platform information, including salesperson profiles, headshots, contact or profile details, lists, and other assigned information or assets within Seismic.
4. Execute Seismic work supporting marketing and sales initiatives, campaigns, newsletters, events, field rollouts, and other activation needs based on defined requirements.
5. Execute defined platform configuration changes, workflow updates, automation, and connected experiences.
6. Test platform changes, enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities using defined test scenarios; document results and report defects, discrepancies, or unexpected behavior.
7. Create and maintain platform procedures, administrator documentation, user guides, training materials, FAQs, and onboarding resources based on established processes.
8. Support user onboarding, training, feature education, and other enablement activities by preparing materials, demonstrating established processes, and completing assigned support activities.
9. Apply established governance, taxonomy, naming, publishing, and access standards to help ensure content and platform information are accurate, findable, current, and available to the appropriate users.
10. Perform routine platform and content quality assurance, including validating content, metadata, links, profile information, access, navigation, and other assigned platform elements.
11. Perform recurring platform and content maintenance, including identifying and addressing outdated, expired, duplicate, incorrectly categorized, or otherwise inaccurate information according to established processes and direction.
12. Support resolution of assigned Seismic user and platform issues by completing routine troubleshooting, documenting resolutions, and escalating issues that require additional platform, integration, technical, or business expertise.
13. Build, configure, update, and maintain assigned Seismic experiences, which may include Pages, LiveDocs, digital sales rooms, email experiences, microapps, and other capabilities, based on defined requirements and direction from onshore Seismic staff.
14. Produce recurring content, usage, adoption, and platform reporting and maintain assigned dashboards according to established requirements.
15. Track assigned work and requests through completion, maintain accurate records, communicate status, and raise risks, dependencies, or unclear requirements early.
16. Coordinate work and handoffs with onshore Seismic staff, content owners, Marketing Activation, Training and Enablement, Product Owners, Technology and Data partners, enterprise platform teams, and other partners as needed.
17. Identify recurring user issues, content problems, broken experiences, or inefficient processes and escalate them to the appropriate onshore partner for evaluation and direction.
18. Support additional Seismic capabilities and processes as they are introduced, learning and executing new procedures as RIS use of the platform evolves.

**Qualifications**

1. Hands-on experience working in Seismic or a comparable sales enablement, content management, or digital experience platform.
2. Experience publishing and maintaining content, metadata, tagging, content properties, permissions, users, and other platform information.
3. Strong attention to detail and quality-control skills, with the ability to accurately execute defined platform and content changes.
4. Experience with user and access administration, including onboarding, access changes, user lists, profile maintenance, and routine access issues.

jobs.title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

To own KPI tracking, measurement readiness, defect follow-up and stakeholder coordination for assigned Bajaj App and Website modules. The role strengthens the POD operating model by translating module objectives into measurable dashboards, validating tracking requirements for Build initiatives and running a disciplined production monitoring cadence for customer experience, digital funnel and platform stability metrics.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Own KPI tracker and dashboard governance for assigned module across App and Website.
* Partner with Product Manager and Technology teams to validate event requirements, tracking plans, dashboard readiness and release acceptance criteria.
* Monitor funnel performance, CTR, conversion, task success, feature adoption, bounce rate, frustration score, crash-free sessions and performance metrics.
* Coordinate defect closure, KPI breakage investigation and production issue follow-up with Engineering, QA, Martech and TechOps.
* Prepare weekly module performance summaries with insights, risks, dependency status and action owners.

  
  
**Additional Accountabilities Pertaining to the Role**  

* Identify recurring gaps in instrumentation, dashboards, releases or monitoring and recommend process improvements.
* Support sprint planning by highlighting KPI dependencies, reporting readiness and ageing blockers.
* Contribute to customer-experience improvement ideas using behavioral analytics and platform performance data.

  
  
**KRA Weightage and Metrics**  

* KPI Tracking (Business Insights) 25%: CTR, conversion rate, feature adoption, funnel completion, reporting accuracy. Maintain clear KPI visibility and identify drivers of performance movement.
* Production Run Defect Governance 20%: Incident count, MTTR support, defect closure, defect leakage, API latency. Improve defect closure discipline and reduce repeat KPI breakages.
* Build Readiness Sprint Support 15%: Requirement readiness, user story acceptance criteria, release success rate. Ensure all KPI requirements are testable and release-ready.
* Customer Experience Analytics 15%: Bounce rate, frustration score, rage clicks, task success, customer effort score. Surface journey friction and support CX improvement actions.
* Stakeholder POD Governance 15%: Dependency closure, escalation TAT, decision documentation. Maintain cadence, action logs and accountable stakeholder follow-up.
* Compliance Control 10%: UAT evidence, SOP adherence, audit observations. Ensure measurement and release documentation are audit-ready.

  
  
**Key Decisions / Dimensions**  

* Approve module-level KPI readiness checklist for Product review.
* Recommend escalation of ageing defects, repeated KPI breakages and customer-impacting performance deviations.
* Prioritize reporting fixes and analysis requests based on business impact and journey criticality.
* Direct financial ownership: Supports module targets by ensuring KPI visibility, funnel tracking and performance issue escalation.

  
  
**Major Challenges**  

* Balancing sprint delivery support with daily run monitoring requires disciplined prioritization.
* KPI ownership depends on accurate instrumentation across multiple channels and tools.
* Stakeholder alignment is critical because defects and latency issues may sit across Product, Martech, IT and Engineering teams.

  
  
**Required Qualifications and Experience**  
  
**Skills and Knowledge**  

* **Educational Qualifications**: Engineer as base qualification: BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related discipline preferred.
* Coding exposure is required; working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript tagging concepts or shell scripting is preferred.
* Certification or hands-on training in digital analytics, observability, product analytics, cloud monitoring or agile delivery is an added advantage.

  
  
**Work Experience**  

* Experience Range: 3-6 years
* Experience in digital analytics, product operations, TechOps, app/web performance monitoring, UAT governance or business reporting.
* Hands-on exposure to GA4, Firebase, CleverTap, Power BI, New Relic, Datadog, JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to convert data into actionable insights and coordinate closure across Product, Tech, Design and Martech teams.

  
  
**Tools / Platforms**  

* Azure DevOps, JIRA, GA4, CleverTap, Contentsquare, New Relic, Firebase, Power BI, Datadog, Figma, Zeplin, Adobe, DAM, CMS, KPI Portal, Medallia, Mixpanel, Postman and Splunk, with depth aligned to grade.

  
  
**Assumptions Used**  

* Experience range, reporting line and team size are aligned to the level framework and may be finalized by HR during role calibration.

**Job Summary**  

IT PMO (Partnerships): Own end-to-end solutioning, system architecture, and API-led partner integrations, driving cross-system delivery from requirement discussions to go-live across the BFL.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Drive end-to-end solutioning for partner integrations, covering JV and co-lending journeys across 4W/TWF flows.
* Lead detailed requirement discussions with partner teams, translating into US/UD aligned to BFL partnership framework.
* Design and own integration architecture across systems: Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS.
* Define and govern API flows including Create Application, KFS generation, Cancel, Status, Webhooks, and Additional Info APIs.
* Ensure correct mapping of data fields, product configurations, and BRE logic across SFDC and Middleware layers.
* Act as solution SPOC, coordinating with API, DB, Middleware, SFDC, BRE, and Data Lake teams for seamless delivery.
* Drive partner onboarding, including API specs alignment, CUG/UAT execution, webhook setup, and production readiness.
* Manage end-to-end delivery timelines for partners, tracking dependencies like SFDC Convert, API readiness, and partner callbacks.
* Lead UAT readiness for flows, including test data setup, journey validation, defect closure, and go-live sign-offs.
* Monitor funnel metrics, disbursal flows, and API performance, ensuring scalability and stability post go-live training to IT staff and end-users on SCCM and Intune usage and capabilities.

  
  
**Key Decisions / Dimensions**  

* Solution Design Across Systems: Defining scalable integration architecture across partners, Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS while balancing speed vs reusability.
* Managing Changing Requirements: Handling evolving partner/COE requirements and deciding scope freeze vs CR during UAT and delivery phases.
* Dependency Timeline Control: Navigating critical dependencies (SFDC Convert, APIs, partner readiness) and deciding parallel vs sequential execution.
* Partner Readiness Go-Live Calls: Driving partner integration (APIs, webhooks, mapping) and taking go-live decisions despite partial readiness.
* Compliance Data Accuracy: Ensuring RBI DLG compliance, correct data mapping, and reconciliation across systems without impacting business timelines.
* Manage Business Volume: > 3000 Cr. a year

  
  
**Major Challenges**  

* Complex cross-system delivery dependencies: Managing integrations across partners, Middleware, DL, 3in1, SFDC, SFDC MW and LMS with evolving requirements, partner readiness gaps, and limited control over external teams.
* Balancing accuracy, compliance timelines: Ensuring correct data mapping, reconciliation, and RBI DLG compliance while still meeting aggressive go-live and business delivery timelines.

  
  
**Required Qualifications and Experience**  
  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology; MBA preferred.
* 3-4 years of experience in IT PMO / Product / Solution roles (preferably BFSI / Fintech).
* Strong conceptual understanding of API architecture and system integrations.
* Knowledge of co-lending / JV lending models and digital lending ecosystem.
* Familiarity with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (DLG), consent management, and compliance frameworks.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies, requirement documentation (US/UD/BRD).

  
  
**Work Experience**  

* Experience working on BFL Partnership Architecture (Partner Systems, Partner MW, PMW DB, DL, HMW, BRE, Risk, 3-in-1, 3-in-1 MW, COSMOS, SFDC, Pennant LMS).
* Hands-on involvement in API integrations (Create Application, KFS, Status, Cancel, Webhooks, Additional Info APIs).
* Experience in solutioning and system design for co-lending/JV journeys, preferably with BFDL or similar partners.
* Working knowledge of SFDC (LOS), Middleware layers (PMW/HMW), and LMS (Pennant).
* Exposure to BRE logic, offer generation, and credit decision workflows.
* Experience in partner onboarding, API integration testing (CUG/UAT), and go-live execution.
* Hands-on experience in UAT cycles (IT + Biz), test data setup, and defect management.
* Experience in data mapping, reconciliation, and multi-system data validation.
* Ability to manage cross-functional coordination across Dev, Middleware, SFDC, Risk, and Partner teams.
* Experience in tracking funnel metrics, API performance, and system KPIs.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled **ServiceNow Developer** with 5 years of experience. In this role, you will drive the design, development, and optimization of ServiceNow implementations across multiple modules\u2014including ITSM, CSM, FSM, and EAM\u2014while also focusing on third-party integrations, identity access management (IAM), and role-based access control (RBAC). As part of a growing Australian team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to shape digital transformation initiatives that support enterprise-level business objectives.

**Job Responsibilities:**

  

**Platform Design & Development**

* Configure, develop, and customize core ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, CSM, FSM, and EAM to meet evolving business needs.
* Create and manage advanced workflows, forms, business rules, and UI policies.
* Drive platform enhancements, version upgrades, and solution design while adhering to best practices.

**Integration & Automation**

* Architect and implement integrations with third-party systems (SailPoint, Jira, SCCM, Azure, GCP) using REST/SOAP APIs, Service Graph Connectors, and other relevant technologies.
* Automate service provisioning and deprovisioning using Flow Designer, orchestrations, and custom scripts

**IAM & RBAC Implementation**

* Establish and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) within ServiceNow, ensuring secure and efficient user provisioning.
* Develop Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) policies and workflows, including role assignments, approvals, and auditing.
* Collaborate with security and compliance teams to maintain governance and adherence to privacy regulations (e.g., Australian Privacy Act).

**Platform Administration & Support**

* Monitor system health, troubleshoot incidents, and recommend solutions to ensure platform stability.
* Conduct root cause analysis for complex issues, coordinating with internal teams to implement preventative measures.
* Maintain high-quality technical documentation, including development guidelines, design documents, and platform policies.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with business analysts, project managers, and key stakeholders to gather requirements and propose optimal technical solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews) to maintain transparency and meet project milestones.
* Mentor junior developers, enforce coding standards, and champion best practices in ServiceNow development.

**Agile Delivery & Collaboration**

* Work within an Agile delivery framework, participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with scrum masters, product owners, and cross-functional teams to refine user stories, estimate tasks, and ensure timely feature delivery.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance efficiency and quality.

jobs.title: Service Improvement Analyst
jobs.description:
The **Service Improvement Analyst Digital Workplace Services** is responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and driving service improvement opportunities across the Digital Workplace Services portfolio. This role focuses on enhancing the end-user experience, improving service performance, optimizing operational processes, and increasing adoption of modern workplace technologies.

Leveraging **ITIL, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX)** principles, the analyst partners with service owners, engineering teams, operations teams, vendors, and clients to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and measure outcomes. The role requires a strong combination of analytical skills, customer focus, business acumen, and technical understanding of modern workplace services such as Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and end-user computing services.

The Service Improvement Analyst will lead improvement initiatives across multiple clients and business functions while ensuring service delivery aligns with business objectives, user expectations, and operational excellence standards.

Key Responsibilities

Service Improvement & Digital Workplace Optimization

* Lead the development and execution of service improvement initiatives across Digital Workplace Services in partnership with Service Excellence Leads, Service Owners, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Analyze service performance, user experience data, operational metrics, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive continual improvement programs focused on enhancing employee productivity, service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Establish improvement roadmaps aligned with Digital Workplace Services strategy and business objectives.
* Support the adoption and optimization of workplace technologies including Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint services, mobility solutions, and digital employee experience tools.
* Utilize Digital Employee Experience (DEX) insights, service analytics, and user sentiment data to prioritize and implement service improvements.

Process Excellence & Operational Effectiveness

* Develop a thorough understanding of existing Digital Workplace processes, workflows, and service delivery models to identify optimization opportunities.
* Create and maintain operational process documentation including: Process maps and flowcharts Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Capacity and utilization studies Time and motion studies Standard work documentation Cycle-time and workflow analysis
* Lead process redesign initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, standardization, and service quality.
* Coordinate and track improvement activities resulting from Kaizen workshops, problem-solving sessions, and operational reviews.
* Implement Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Continuous Improvement methodologies to drive measurable outcomes.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights

* Define, monitor, and report on key Digital Workplace Services KPIs and SLAs, including: Service Desk performance End-user experience metrics Incident and request trends Availability and reliability metrics Adoption and utilization metrics Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Employee experience measures
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis and trend analysis to proactively address recurring service issues.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making to recommend service enhancements and operational improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership

* Lead cross-functional service improvement initiatives involving Operations, Engineering, Service Management, Product Teams, Vendors, and Client stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and point of contact for service improvement programs and transformation efforts.
* Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and continuous improvement sessions with business and technical teams.
* Deliver Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Continual Improvement, and service management training and awareness sessions.
* Mentor Yellow and Green Belt practitioners and support the organization's continuous improvement culture.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize and implement approved improvements that increase service value, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

Governance & Best Practices

* Promote and enforce ITIL and continual improvement best practices across Digital Workplace Services.
* Support service governance activities, operational reviews, and improvement boards.
* Ensure improvement initiatives are measured, documented, and sustained through appropriate governance and change management practices.
* Drive the identification, adoption, and continuous improvement of scalable end-to-end service delivery processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Service Improvement, Process Improvement, Business Analysis, Service Management, or a related role.
* 2+ years of experience applying Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Experience supporting or improving Digital Workplace Services environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of identifying improvement opportunities and delivering measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience documenting and optimizing business and operational processes.
* Experience working cross-functionally within complex organizational environments.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with global and remote teams.
* Excellent reporting, dashboard creation, and performance measurement experience.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Teams, and Visio.
* Strong understanding of service management principles, KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms such as Nexthink, Lakeside, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management, Intune, Windows Services, Collaboration Platforms, and Modern Workplace technologies.
* Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, and service analytics platforms.
* Experience in managed services or enterprise IT environments.

jobs.title: Manager - Education Loan
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**   
Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.   
  
**Duties and Responsibilities**   
- Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
- Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
- Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
- Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
- Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
- Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
- Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
- Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
- Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
- Drive cluster portfolio quality through regular review of X-bucket and early-delinquency trends, allocation and monitoring of follow-up actions, root-cause identification and coordinated resolution with Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations.
- Translate business plans into cluster execution priorities.
- Review team productivity, sourcing quality, controls and capability.
- Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks and escalate structural issues with evidence.
**Key Decisions / Dimensions**   
- Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
- Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
- Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
- Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.  
  Key interactions  
  Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.  
  External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.

- Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
- Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
- Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
- Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.
  
  
**Required Qualifications and Experience**   
Graduate or postgraduate with demonstrated experience managing a sales team, geography or lending portfolio.  
Critical skills and knowledge  
- Education Loan customer counselling
- Sales execution and relationship management
- Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
- Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
- Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
- CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
- Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
- Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
- Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
- High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

**Location- Hyderabad**

**Position - Contractual role**

The Lead Expert, GES R2D FPA is responsible for leading financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis and management reporting activities. The role delivers accurate, timely and data-driven insights that support executive decision-making and help the organisation achieve its strategic, operational and financial objectives.

Working as a senior individual contributor, the Lead Expert independently manages complex FPA deliverables while partnering with Group FPA, business-unit finance, operational controllers and other stakeholders to strengthen financial visibility, resolve issues and improve business performance.

  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**FPA activities:**  

* Deliver insightful variance analysis (Actuals vs Budget vs Forecast) and Sales Gross Margin (GM) analysis to support performance tracking.
* Evaluate historical and current financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for growth.
* Develop and deliver high-quality financial and KPI reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for senior stakeholders.
* Manage end-to-end rebate calculations and accrual postings, ensuring accurate revenue recognition and alignment with financial policies and reporting timelines
* PL consolidation across business units, delivering timely and accurate financial insights to support performance tracking and executive decision-making
* Strengthen month-end close and reporting processes by improving accrual accuracy, variance analysis, and reconciliation, enhancing overall financial visibility and control
* Strengthen reporting frameworks to improve visibility, accuracy, and timeliness of business performance.
* Support leadership presentations with clear, concise, and actionable financial insights.
* Own and enhance OPEX reporting by cost center and business unit, leveraging existing systems.
* Support inventory consolidation and analysis, providing insights on stock levels, valuation.
* Collaborate with supply chain and finance teams to enhance inventory efficiency and controls.
* Act as a key finance business partner to commercial, operations, and local finance teams.
* Manage and deliver ad hoc analysis and reporting requests from business stakeholders.
* Drive automation and digital transformation initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve reporting speed.

  
  
**Competence**  

* Financial Planning Forecasting
* Budgeting Variance Analysis
* Data Analysis Financial Modeling
* Business PartneringStakeholder Management
* Management Reporting Insights Generation
* Strong Excel Financial Systems (SAP/Power BI)
* Understanding of Financial Statements
* Attention to Detail Data Accuracy
* Problem Solving Analytical Thinking
* Communication Presentation Skills

  
  
**You Bring**  

* Bachelors or masters degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or MBA Finance are advantageous.
* 6-10 years of relevant experience in FPA, finance business partnering, or financial controlling.
* Significant experience in FPA, controlling, commercial finance, management accounting or business finance.
* Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders.
* Exposure to multinational, shared services or global finance environments is valuable.
* Experience leading finance transformation, standardisation or automation initiatives is desirable.

**Job Summary**

Do you want to shape the future of fintech and healthtech? Energized by challenges and inspired by bold goals? Ready to elevate your career alongside driven and talented colleagues? If that sounds like you, explore a career at Alegeus today.

**Opportunity Happens Here**.

**Responsibilities**

Alegeus is modernizing into an API first, open integration platform that powers partners, employers, and participants across consumer-directed-healthcare. You will own the Integrations product surface so that partners can integrate faster with higher reliability, enabling new experiences and AI/agentic workflows. Integration

**Ownership Scope**

You will own all external integration modalities at Alegeus, including:

* Data integrations: Public APIs, webhooks, event streams, real-time interfaces, and asynchronous messaging patterns
* File-based integrations: EDI, CSV, batch processing, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)
* Experience integrations: front-end microservices, embeddable widgets, and partner-facing UI extensions
* This role ensures that the above is designed, delivered, and evolved as one cohesive platform, not disconnected channels, with shared standards for security, versioning, observability, reliability, and partner experience.

**Outcomes you'll own**

* Reduce partner time to first value and increase adoption across key use cases.
* Ship a coherent v2 API set with clear versioning, deprecation, and a reliable release cadence.
* Launch a webhook/event framework (subscribe, replay, DLQ, idempotency) with partnergrade SLAs.
* Deliver a developer experience that delights: dev portal, docs, SDKs, samples, error taxonomy, sandbox, chatbot, etc.
* Establish product analytics KPIs (adoption, latency, reliability, errors, partner NPS) with dashboards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for Data, File and Experience integrations; define problem statements, success metrics, and crisp PRDs.
* Partner with design/engineering/Product owners to deliver secure, scalable interfaces and reference implementations.
* Work directly with marquee partners to map JTBD and translate into stable contracts/schemas.
* Drive packaging, auth models (OAuth/OIDC), rate limits, quotas, SLAs, and change management.
* Orchestrate launches: docs, changelogs, guides, enablement, and internal readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-10+ years in PM with SaaS integrations as your product (not just "has APIs").
* Hands-on track record shipping public REST APIs and webhooks at scale; familiarity with async patterns, retries, backoff, and event semantics.
* Strong grasp of DX: information architecture for docs, quickstarts, SDK stewardship, error design.
* Data exchange expertise: realtime + bulk, schema evolution, validation, and observability for integrations.
* Excellent partner-facing skills: discovery, solutioning, negotiating tradeoffs, clear communication.

**Nice to have**

* Healthcare, claims/eligibility, fintech/payments, or benefits ecosystem experience.
* API monetization/packaging, partner marketplaces, or appecosystem playbooks.
* Observability for integrations (schema drift detection, tracing, deadlettering, replay tools).

**How we'll measure success**

* Adoption of v2 endpoints webhook subscriptions; reduction in partner integration time.
* Reliability (SLO attainment), latency improvements, and error rate reductions for integration flows.

**About Wego**

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We dont just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, whats next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are** **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

**Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

**This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **Youd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

3. Data, Analytics & Experimentation  
Develop a strong understanding of product and business metrics, identify trends and proactively surface opportunities or problems.  
Perform deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations to understand changes in business performance.  
Formulate hypotheses, design experiments and evaluate results using data-driven approaches.  
Build measurement frameworks to assess the incremental impact of product and monetisation initiatives.  
Work with analytics and data teams to improve dashboards, tracking and decision-making frameworks.  
4. Product Strategy & Execution  
Identify, evaluate and prioritise product opportunities based on business impact, user value and execution complexity.

Navigate ambiguity, challenge existing assumptions and continuously look for better ways to solve business problems.

3+ years of experience in Product Management, Growth, Monetisation or related roles.

Strong business acumen and an understanding of revenue drivers, unit economics and growth levers.  
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.  
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high ownership and accountability.

Experience in consumer mobile applications, particularly content, gaming, entertainment or other high-engagement products.  
Understanding of mobile advertising ecosystems, including AdMob, AppLovin, Unity, Meta Audience Network, mediation platforms and programmatic advertising.  
Experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks and product analytics tools.  
Familiarity with SQL, analytics platforms and working with large datasets.

Build and execute a prioritised product roadmap for ads monetisation and retention, aligned with key business objectives.  
Drive measurable improvements in advertising revenue and monetisation efficiency through data-driven initiatives and experimentation.  
Identify key drivers of user behaviour and implement initiatives that improve engagement and long-term retention while balancing ad experience.  
Develop deep business and product understanding, demonstrate strong first-principles thinking, and independently drive initiatives end-to-end with high ownership and accountability.

You will have significant contact with customers and partners at a strategic level, to ensure that requirements and changing market demands are incorporated into product design and development.*

  

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent is required, Masters degree and MBA degree are a plus
* Minimum 8 years of experience in product management or related roles with product aspects and customer facing elements such as product marketing, strategy, business development, or solution architecture
* Know-how of the telecommunications market and related technologies, big data and AI applications; experience in Wi-Fi, Mobile, and Cyber Security domains is a plus
* Customer oriented, business sense, able to work with marketing and sales proactively to develop new value propositions and drive business growth
* Experience with lean product processes and agile SW/SaaS development life cycles
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong communication and presentation skills; ability to communicate and convey messages clearly
* Passionate about the products and technology, self-motivated and independent, with the ability to plan work effectively in a dynamic multi-project environment
* Data driven and result-oriented, proven ability to take initiative and generate results needed to reach goals and monitor progress
* Ability to bond and collaborate with stakeholders and partners, manage conflicting priorities, and negotiate features and requests from customers and turn them into requirements for R&D
* Comfortable to travel internationally to visit customers and partners
* Team player who interacts easily with the different layers of the companys management

  

**Responsibilities**

* The responsibility offered comprises assisting in defining the strategy for Airties Connectivity Experience Management solutions and adjacent products
* You follow relevant market trends, technology evolutions, standard evolutions and partner supplier roadmaps based on market reports, technology announcements, meetings and customer visits
* You perform regular benchmarking, competitive analysis, technology evaluations and stakeholder interviews
* You identify the market needs and define end-to-end solutions that address them in a differentiating way
* You present internal reviews comprising technology evaluation, competitive positioning, business model canvas and related business case and go-to-market
* You participate in user testing activities
* You deliver use case definitions and user experience designs towards R&D
* You drive as business owner the virtual feature team of the features/solutions/modules you are working on until they are ready for planning, and you participate in driving the content in upcoming phases
* You identify gaps in the solution and give recommendations how to fill them
* You work together with Marketing teams and use data from customers and internal data, to ensure clear positioning and benefits of the features/solutions
* You ensure the right proof of value, price and cost of the features/modules/solutions you are responsible for
* You produce necessary sales trainings and associated documents (datasheets, roadmaps, launch kits, white papers, commercial and marketing pitches) in collaboration with Marketing teams
* You generate externally usable material such as white papers, presentations, data sheets and competitive positioning clearly demonstrating and enhancing Airties leading position
* You promote your product to the internal and external stakeholders
* You work in close cooperation with sales, customers and partners, and support the sales team in pre-sales efforts together with solution architects
* You ensure proper alignment with sales to maintain a positive business plan for your technologies and find champions to introduce your product to customers
* You conduct quarterly strategy reviews to assess the success of your features/solution/module choices and advise and recommend the strategy to be followed and decisions to be taken
* You represent the vision of Airties towards customers and the vision of its customers towards the organization
